domains.name: production
domains.description: Core manufacturing execution domain governing shop floor control, work orders, routing, scheduling, WIP tracking, cycle time, takt time, throughput, and OEE. Integrates with MES (Siemens Opcenter) and ERP (SAP PP) to orchestrate production runs, machine assignments, capacity planning, and shift-level output reporting via SCADA/DCS systems.

products.name: production_work_order
products.description: Core manufacturing work order representing a discrete production job issued to the shop floor. Authorizes manufacture of a specific quantity of finished or semi-finished goods by linking a routing, BOM revision, and production version. Tracks planned vs. actual dates, priority, order status, WIP value, and completion percentage. The SSOT for all production execution activity within this domain. Sourced from ERP production orders (e.g., SAP PP) and MES work order management (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).

Sourced from ERP production planning (e.g., SAP PP) and APS systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain).

products.name: routing
products.description: Manufacturing routing master defining the ordered sequence of operations required to produce a finished or semi-finished item. Captures routing number, routing type (production, inspection, universal), base quantity, status, and validity dates. Each routing is composed of individual operations (modeled as line items) linked to work centers with standard times for setup, machine run, and labor. The SSOT for standard production process definitions. Sourced from ERP routing master (e.g., SAP CA01) and PLM process plans (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter).

attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) that defines the material components consumed by this routing. Links routing to BOM for integrated production planning.

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecn. Business justification: The ecn.routing_impact_flag explicitly signals that ECNs can mandate routing changes. Tracing which ECN triggered a routing update is required for engineering change management audits and to validate

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or finished good that this routing produces. Links to the material master in inventory domain.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility where this routing is executed. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: FK to production.production_line

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: Routings are revision-controlled and valid only for a specific engineering revision of a part. Manufacturing engineers require this link to enforce that the correct routing version is used when a new

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this routing was approved for production use.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the routing. Pending routings await review; approved routings are authorized for production; rejected routings require rework; under_review routings are in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this routing for production use.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: Standard lot size or batch quantity for which the routing times and resource requirements are defined. All operation times are calculated relative to this base quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity. Standard ISO unit codes such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter).

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Notice (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) number that authorized the creation or last modification of this routing. Supports traceability of process changes.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the routing process or path

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost amount.

attributes.name: counter
attributes.description: Sequential counter within the routing group. Together with routing_group, forms an alternative business key.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this routing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the routing purpose, scope, and special instructions. Provides context for production planners and shop floor operators.

attributes.name: is_default_routing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing is the default routing for the material. True if this is the primary routing; false if it is an alternative.

attributes.name: is_phantom_routing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a phantom routing that is automatically consumed without generating a separate production order. Used for subassemblies that are immediately incorporated into parent assemblies.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this routing record was last modified.

attributes.name: last_used_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this routing was used in a production order or work order. Used to identify obsolete or inactive routings.

attributes.name: lot_size_from
attributes.description: Minimum lot size for which this routing is applicable. Supports lot-size-dependent routing selection.

attributes.name: lot_size_to
attributes.description: Maximum lot size for which this routing is applicable. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the routing

attributes.name: planner_group
attributes.description: Production planning team or planner responsible for maintaining and scheduling this routing.

attributes.name: routing_group
attributes.description: Grouping code for related routings. Used to organize routings by product family, process type, or manufacturing cell.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing. Externally visible routing code used in production planning and shop floor documentation.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Draft routings are under development; released routings are approved for use; active routings are currently in production; inactive routings are temporarily suspended; obsolete routings are retired; blocked routings are prohibited from use.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing purpose. Production routings define standard manufacturing sequences; inspection routings define quality check sequences; rework routings define repair processes; universal routings apply across multiple materials; rate routings define continuous process flows; reference routings serve as templates.

attributes.name: scheduling_type
attributes.description: Scheduling strategy for this routing. Forward scheduling starts from the earliest start date; backward scheduling works back from the required finish date; midpoint scheduling balances around a target date.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this routing in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost to execute this routing for the base quantity. Includes labor, machine, overhead, and tooling costs. Used for cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Extended free-form text field for detailed routing notes, special handling instructions, safety warnings, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: total_labor_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative labor time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Labor time may scale differently than machine time.

attributes.name: total_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Total cumulative lead time in hours required to complete all operations in this routing for the base quantity. Includes setup, machine, labor, and queue times.

attributes.name: total_machine_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative machine processing time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Machine time scales with lot size.

attributes.name: total_operation_count
attributes.description: Total number of operations (steps) defined in this routing. Derived from routing operation line items.

attributes.name: total_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative setup time in minutes across all operations for the base quantity. Setup time is independent of lot size.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Intended application context for the routing. Standard routings are the default production method; alternative routings provide backup processes; trial routings support pilot runs; prototype routings support R&D; emergency routings address contingency scenarios.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this routing has been used in production orders or work orders. Indicates routing popularity and stability.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which this routing is valid and can be used in production planning and execution.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date after which this routing is no longer valid. Null indicates indefinite validity.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the routing. Supports versioning of routing definitions to track engineering changes and process improvements.

products.name: shift
products.description: Shift definition master representing a named working period pattern for a plant or work center. Defines shift code, start/end times, break structure, net available minutes, and shift type (regular, overtime, weekend). Used as the time-boundary reference for capacity planning, OEE shift-level reporting, takt time calculation, and workforce scheduling integration.
products.reference: SAP PP Shift Definition / Opcenter Shift

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift definition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Links shift to its site location, enabling shift‑level labor cost and safety incident aggregation per plant.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Shifts are defined at the plant level in manufacturing. A shift pattern (e.g., Day/Afternoon/Night) is configured per plant to reflect local labor agreements, timezone, and operational requirements. T

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work center or production line where this shift is applicable. Nullable if the shift applies plant-wide. Used for capacity planning and machine-specific scheduling.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Sum of all scheduled break periods (lunch, rest breaks) within the shift, in minutes. Subtracted from gross duration to calculate net available time for production.

attributes.name: break_schedule
attributes.description: Textual description of the break structure, including start times and durations (e.g., '10:00-10:15 (15 min), 12:00-12:30 (30 min)'). Used for communication to shop floor personnel and HMI display.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Broad categorization of shift purpose. Production shifts are used for manufacturing execution and OEE calculation; non-production shifts (e.g., maintenance, training) are excluded from throughput metrics; mixed shifts include both activities.

attributes.name: changeover_allowance_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time reserved within the shift for product changeovers, tool changes, or setup activities. Used to adjust net available time for multi-product shifts and to calculate planned downtime for OEE.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the shift pattern (e.g., DAY_1, NIGHT_A, SWING_2). Used as the externally-known reference in scheduling systems and MES.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift definition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Standard number of operators or workers assigned to this shift pattern. Used for labor capacity planning and cost allocation. Nullable if crew size varies by work center.

attributes.name: days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of weekday codes (MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN) indicating which days this shift pattern applies to. Used for weekly capacity planning and workforce rostering.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Description of the shift

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this shift definition is no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended shift patterns. Used to retire obsolete shift definitions while preserving historical data.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this shift definition becomes active and can be used for production scheduling. Supports versioning of shift patterns over time.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Time of day when the shift ends, in HH:mm:ss format (24-hour clock). May be less than start_time for shifts that cross midnight. Used to calculate gross shift duration.

attributes.name: gross_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the shift from start to end, in minutes, including all breaks and non-productive time. Used as the denominator for availability calculations.

attributes.name: handover_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned overlap time between consecutive shifts for handover communication, equipment status review, and safety briefing. Subtracted from net available time if included in shift boundaries. Nullable for non-continuous operations.

attributes.name: is_continuous_operation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is part of a 24/7 continuous manufacturing operation (True) or a discrete batch operation (False). Used to determine handover requirements and WIP tracking rules.

attributes.name: labor_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base labor rates for this shift type (e.g., 1.0 for regular, 1.5 for overtime, 2.0 for holiday). Used for labor cost calculation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this shift definition record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift definition record was last updated. Used for audit trail and to track the currency of master data.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the shift (e.g., Day Shift, Night Shift, Morning Shift). Used for display in reports and HMI screens.

attributes.name: net_available_minutes
attributes.description: Net productive time available for manufacturing execution, calculated as gross_duration_minutes minus break_duration_minutes. Used as the planned production time for OEE availability calculation and takt time planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information about the shift pattern, special instructions, or exceptions. Used for communication to planners and supervisors.

attributes.name: number_of_breaks
attributes.description: Count of distinct break periods scheduled within the shift (e.g., 2 for a shift with one lunch break and one rest break). Used for workforce scheduling and labor compliance reporting.

attributes.name: planned_output_quantity
attributes.description: Target production volume for this shift, in base unit of measure. Used as the denominator for performance OEE calculation and as input to takt time calculation. Nullable for non-production shifts.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for shift selection when multiple shift definitions are valid for the same time period (lower number = higher priority). Used by APS systems to resolve scheduling conflicts.

attributes.name: rotation_pattern
attributes.description: Description of the multi-day or multi-week rotation cycle this shift belongs to (e.g., '2-2-3 Continental', '4-on-4-off', 'DuPont 12-hour'). Used for long-term workforce scheduling and fatigue management.

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this shift within a daily rotation (e.g., 1 for first shift, 2 for second shift, 3 for third shift). Used for shift handover reporting and continuous production tracking.

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift definition. Active shifts are available for scheduling; inactive shifts are temporarily disabled; draft shifts are under review; archived shifts are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift pattern indicating the nature of the working period. Regular shifts are standard production periods; overtime, weekend, and holiday shifts may carry premium labor rates; maintenance and emergency shifts are non-production periods.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Time of day when the shift begins, in HH:mm:ss format (24-hour clock). Used to calculate shift boundaries for production tracking and OEE reporting.

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Target cycle time per unit to meet customer demand, calculated as net_available_minutes * 60 / planned_output_quantity. Used for production pacing and line balancing. Nullable if not applicable to this shift type.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the plant location where this shift operates (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Shanghai). Used to convert shift boundaries to UTC for global reporting and to handle daylight saving time transitions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for planned_output_quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters). Must align with material master UOM for the products manufactured during this shift.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this shift definition record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

products.name: wip_lot
products.description: Work-in-progress (WIP) lot or batch tracking entity representing a discrete quantity of material currently being processed through the production routing. Captures lot number, material number, current operation, current work center, quantity in process, quantity completed, quantity scrapped, lot creation timestamp, and lot status (in-process, on-hold, completed, scrapped). Enables real-time WIP visibility, genealogy tracing, and shop floor material flow tracking. Sourced from MES lot tracking (e.g., Siemens Opcenter).

attributes.name: wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work-in-progress lot or batch. Primary key for the WIP lot tracking entity.

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bom_header. Business justification: Regulatory traceability (ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR Part 820) requires recording which BOM header (production version) was active when a WIP lot was manufactured. wip_lot has routing_id but no BOM header re

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecn. Business justification: WIP lots in process when an ECN is released require disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap). Linking wip_lot to the governing ECN is a standard change management requirement enabling planners to identi

attributes.name: eco_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.eco. Business justification: Lots produced under a specific engineering change order need linkage for compliance and cost reporting.

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_specification. Business justification: WIP lots must be produced to a specific engineering specification. Quality holds and MRB (Material Review Board) disposition decisions require knowing which specification governed the lot, especially

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Lot traceability to the sales order is required for compliance and customer‑specific quality tracking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Links WIP lot to its plant location for lot traceability and site‑specific quality control.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record representing the product or component being manufactured in this lot.

attributes.name: parent_lot_wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent WIP lot if this lot was split or derived from another lot. Enables genealogy and traceability tracking.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_line. Business justification: A WIP lot is being processed on a specific production line at any given time. Tracking which production line a WIP lot is on is essential for shop floor control, OEE calculation, and throughput analys

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_work_order. Business justification: A WIP lot is generated from a specific production work order; linking removes the ambiguous order number field.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Lot tracking must record the component revision to ensure traceability for quality investigations.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production routing defining the sequence of operations this lot must traverse.

attributes.name: schedule_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.schedule_line. Business justification: MTO lot pegging: WIP lots are pegged to specific order schedule lines for ATP confirmation and delivery scheduling. Enables production-to-delivery traceability at lot level, required for delivery date

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shift. Business justification: The wip_lot table has a shift_code (STRING) column that is a denormalized reference to a shift. Normalizing this to a proper FK shift_id → shift.shift_id enables proper relational integrity and allows

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: WIP lot tracking requires the SKU identifier for traceability, quality inspection, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: WIP lot physical location tracking is required for shop-floor inventory visibility, WIP valuation reports, and material staging. wip_lot.storage_location_code is a denormalized text field that should

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot actually completed all operations and was confirmed as finished. Null if lot is still in process.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch identifier for process industries where multiple lots may be grouped into a single batch for traceability or quality purposes.

attributes.name: current_operation_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number of the operation currently being performed on this lot within the routing. Used to track progress through the production process.

attributes.name: current_operation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lot arrived at and began processing at the current operation. Used for operation cycle time tracking.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Shelf life expiration date for this lot, applicable for materials with limited shelf life such as chemicals, adhesives, or perishable components.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason why this lot is on hold, if applicable. Examples include quality issue, material shortage, engineering change, equipment failure.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Quality inspection lot number assigned by the QM system if this WIP lot is subject to inspection. Links to quality inspection records.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and data synchronization.

attributes.name: lot_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP lot record was created in the MES system, marking the start of lot tracking.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the lot or batch. Human-readable unique code used for tracking and traceability across the shop floor and in MES systems.

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP lot. Indicates whether the lot is released for production, actively in process, on hold, completed, scrapped, or cancelled.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this WIP lot that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: original_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the original lot if this is a rework or split lot. Maintains traceability to the source lot for genealogy purposes.

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Production priority level assigned to this lot. Determines scheduling precedence and resource allocation on the shop floor.

attributes.name: production_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when physical production of this lot began at the first operation. Used for lead time and cycle time calculation.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Project identifier if this lot is being produced for a specific engineering or customer project. Used for project-based manufacturing tracking.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires quality inspection before proceeding to the next operation or before final goods receipt.

attributes.name: quantity_completed
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has successfully completed all operations in the routing and is ready for goods receipt.

attributes.name: quantity_in_process
attributes.description: Current quantity of material actively being processed at the current operation. Represents material that has not yet completed the current step.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hold
attributes.description: Quantity of material in this lot that is currently on hold pending quality inspection, engineering review, or other disposition decision.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Total quantity of material originally planned to be produced in this lot as specified in the production order.

attributes.name: quantity_scrapped
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material that has been rejected or scrapped due to quality defects or process failures during production.

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is a rework lot created to reprocess previously rejected or non-conforming material.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this lot is scheduled to complete all operations and be available for goods receipt. Used for capacity planning and delivery commitment.

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the primary reason for any scrapped quantity in this lot. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Serial number profile code indicating whether and how individual units within this lot are serialized for traceability.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating if this lot represents special stock such as consignment, project stock, or customer-owned material.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields in this lot record (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, M for meters).

products.name: production_goods_receipt
products.description: Goods receipt event recording formal completion and stock posting of finished or semi-finished goods produced against a work order. Captures GR document number, posting date, material, plant, storage location, received quantity, batch number, and movement type (101). Sourced from SAP PP/WM (MIGO). This is the production domain's handoff point — it triggers inventory update in the inventory domain and signals work order completion. Does NOT own ongoing stock balances (inventory domain owns those).
products.reference: SAP PP Goods Receipt (MIGO / Movement Type 101)

attributes.name: production_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production goods receipt event. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecn. Business justification: Goods receipts mark the transition point when an ECN is implemented in production. Tracing which production lots were received before vs. after ECN implementation is required for inventory disposition

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Production goods receipts trigger quality inspection lot creation — in SAP manufacturing, movement type 101 (GR against production order) automatically creates an inspection lot. This FK enables GR-to

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Connects goods receipt to the receiving plant location, supporting traceability and inventory valuation per site.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lot or batch number assigned to the received goods for traceability and quality control purposes.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the finished or semi-finished good that was received. Links to the material being produced.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.mrp_run. Business justification: Goods receipts are posted as a result of an MRP run; linking enables receipt verification against the originating run in the Goods Receipt Reconciliation report.

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Goods receipt from production is the fulfillment event that closes a sales order intake. Sales operations and order management teams track this link to confirm produced quantities are available for sh

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_line. Business justification: Replace string line code with a proper foreign key to the production line entity for referential integrity.

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_work_order. Business justification: Link goods receipt to the work order it finalizes, enabling traceability from receipt to production work order.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: Goods receipts from production must record which engineering revision was manufactured. As-built / as-manufactured records and lot traceability reports require this link to confirm finished goods conf

attributes.name: schedule_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.schedule_line. Business justification: MTO goods receipt pegging: finished goods receipt from production is pegged to the order schedule line to confirm stock availability for that delivery commitment. Standard SAP GR-to-schedule-line pegg

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shift. Business justification: Replace string shift identifier with a foreign key to the shift entity, allowing accurate shift‑level reporting.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Goods receipt records need the SKU to validate received quantity against the product master and enable downstream inventory updates.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location within the plant where the received goods were posted to inventory. Links to warehouse storage location.

attributes.name: wip_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.wip_lot. Business justification: A production goods receipt records the formal completion and stock posting of finished goods from a WIP lot. The GR event closes out the WIP lot by posting the completed quantity to stock. This FK lin

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned to the received goods for traceability. May be system-generated or manually assigned based on batch management configuration.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The production confirmation number from the MES or ERP system that triggered this goods receipt. Links shop floor execution to inventory posting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Reference number from the physical delivery documentation or packing slip accompanying the goods. Used for reconciliation with physical documents.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt document was created or initiated. May differ from posting date in cases of backdated transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the goods receipt was posted. Used for monthly financial closing and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number generated by the ERP system for this goods receipt transaction. This is the business identifier used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt document. Indicates whether the receipt has been successfully posted, reversed, cancelled, or is awaiting quality inspection.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was last updated in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that classifies the type of inventory transaction. For production goods receipts, typically 101 (goods receipt to stock) or 131 (goods receipt from production order).

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the operator or warehouse personnel regarding the goods receipt. Captures exceptions, observations, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity originally planned to be produced on the work order. Used to calculate yield and completion percentage.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory in the ERP system. This is the accounting-effective date for inventory valuation.

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: The system user ID who posted the goods receipt transaction in the ERP system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifies the specific production version (combination of BOM and routing) used to manufacture the goods. Used for process traceability and costing.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods must undergo quality inspection before being released to unrestricted stock. Drives QM workflow.

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the goods were physically received and confirmed on the shop floor or warehouse. Captures the real-world event time for production completion.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of finished or semi-finished goods received and posted to inventory. Measured in the base unit of measure for the material.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: The material reservation number that was created for the work order and fulfilled by this goods receipt. Links production output to material planning.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt was reversed. Provides audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. Used to filter active vs. reversed transactions in reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the goods receipt (e.g., quantity error, wrong material, quality issue). Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material scrapped or rejected during the production run that resulted in this goods receipt. Used for yield calculation and quality analysis.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code indicating if the goods receipt is for special stock types such as consignment, project stock, or sales order stock. Affects inventory valuation and availability.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The type of stock to which the goods were received. Unrestricted stock is available for use, quality inspection stock is awaiting QA approval, blocked stock cannot be used.

products.name: routing_operation
products.description: This association product represents the Operation Step — the assignment of a work center to a specific ordered step within a manufacturing routing. It captures the sequence, standard times, control parameters, and activity types that define what work is performed, where it is performed, and how long it takes at each step of the production process. Each record links one routing to one work center at a specific operation sequence position, carrying attributes that exist only in the context of this routing-step-work_center combination. This is the SSOT for operation-level production process definitions and is the canonical M:N resolution between routing and work_center in all major ERP/MES systems (SAP PP routing operation, Oracle WIP operation, etc.).. Existence Justification: In manufacturing ERP systems (SAP PP, Oracle MFG, etc.), a routing is composed of multiple ordered operation steps, each assigned to a specific work center. A single routing can reference many work centers (e.g., step 10 at Lathe WC, step 20 at Mill WC, step 30 at Assembly WC), and a single work center can appear in many different routings across different products. The routing_operation is the canonical first-class business entity that represents this assignment — it carries operation sequence, standard times, control keys, and activity types that belong to neither the routing nor the work center alone.

attributes.name: operation_sequence_number

attributes.name: processing_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard processing or machine run time in minutes per base quantity unit for this operation step. Belongs to the routing-work_center combination, not to either entity alone.

attributes.name: setup_time_minutes

attributes.name: standard_processing_time_minutes

[Moved from work_center: The standard processing time on work_center represents a generic default, but the actual operation processing time is specific to each routing-work_center combination and belongs on the routing_operation. The work_center default can be retained as a fallback reference value, but the operative time for production scheduling lives on the routing_operation.]

domains.name: engineering
domains.description: Product design and engineering lifecycle domain covering CAD/CAM models, BOMs, ECOs, ECNs, DFM analysis, DFMEA, PFMEA, and PLM data managed in Siemens Teamcenter. Serves as the SSOT for product structure, revision history, engineering change governance, technical specifications, drawings, and prototypes for all manufactured automation systems.

products.name: component
products.description: Master record for every discrete engineered part, sub-assembly, or raw material managed in PLM. Serves as the SSOT for component identity, revision state, lifecycle phase, engineering classification, material specification, weight, dimensional envelope, tolerance class, CAD model reference, PLM item ID, and approved substitutes. Covers all manufactured automation system components including electrification modules, PLCs, HMIs, drives, sensors, and structural enclosures. Includes classification taxonomy (commodity, technology family, functional group) for BOM analytics and sourcing alignment.

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials master record defining the structured product hierarchy for a given component or finished assembly at a specific revision. Captures BOM type (engineering BOM, manufacturing BOM, service BOM), effectivity dates, quantity basis, unit of measure, and the owning PLM item. Acts as the SSOT for product structure consumed by MRP, MES, and production planning.

attributes.name: alternative_bom_indicator
attributes.description: Identifier for alternative BOM variants of the same product, used to represent different manufacturing methods, material substitutions, or regional variations. Blank for primary BOM.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the BOM in the engineering change workflow. Pending indicates awaiting review, Approved means released for use, Rejected means not accepted, Conditional means approved with restrictions or prerequisites.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this BOM revision. Supports audit trail and accountability for engineering change management.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this BOM revision was formally approved for release. Critical for traceability and compliance with engineering change control processes.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The fundamental unit of measure in which the finished product is stocked and sold, independent of the BOM quantity basis. Used for inventory and sales order processing.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, typically a human-readable code used across engineering, manufacturing, and procurement systems. Serves as the externally-known unique reference.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the BOM. Draft indicates work in progress, In Review means under engineering approval, Approved is ready for release, Active is in production use, Obsolete is no longer valid, Superseded has been replaced by a newer revision, and Frozen is locked for regulatory or contractual reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|obsolete|superseded|frozen — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended business purpose. Engineering BOM (EBOM) represents design intent, Manufacturing BOM (MBOM) reflects shop floor assembly, Service BOM supports after-sales maintenance, Sales BOM defines customer-facing configurations, Planning BOM is used for MRP, and As-Maintained BOM tracks actual installed configurations.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the BOM structure. Material BOM lists physical components, Document BOM references technical drawings and specifications, Equipment BOM defines installed assets, Variant BOM supports product families, Configurable BOM enables customer-specific selections.

attributes.name: configuration_profile
attributes.description: Identifier for a variant configuration profile or product family definition. Used in configurable BOMs to define which components are included based on customer selections or feature options.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the BOM cost estimate. Supports multi-currency costing for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_total
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the BOM including all material, labor, and overhead components. Rolled up from component costs and routing operations. Used for product costing and pricing decisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the PLM system. Provides audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the BOM, providing additional context about the product structure, manufacturing method, or special handling requirements. Supplements the BOM number and type.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM revision becomes valid and can be used for production planning, procurement, and manufacturing execution. Supports time-phased BOM management for product transitions.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this BOM revision remains valid. Nullable for open-ended BOMs. Used to manage phase-out of legacy product structures and ensure correct BOM selection in MRP and MES systems.

attributes.name: explosion_type
attributes.description: Defines how the BOM structure should be expanded for planning and execution. Single Level shows only immediate children, Multi Level recursively expands all sub-assemblies, Summarized aggregates quantities across all levels.

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM supports variant configuration, allowing customer-specific or order-specific component selection. True for configurable BOMs, False for fixed BOMs.

attributes.name: is_critical_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this BOM is for a critical or high-value product requiring special handling, approval workflows, or regulatory compliance. True for critical BOMs, False for standard BOMs.

attributes.name: is_phantom_bom
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a phantom (transient) BOM that is not stocked as a discrete item but is exploded through to its components during MRP and production. True for phantom BOMs, False for standard stocked assemblies.

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production lot or batch size for which this BOM is optimized. Used in MRP calculations to determine component requirements and setup costs. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that last modified this BOM record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated. Distinct from approval and effectivity dates. Provides audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or instructions related to this BOM. May include manufacturing guidelines, quality requirements, or special handling instructions for production planning and shop floor execution.

attributes.name: plm_item_code
attributes.description: Reference to the owning PLM item in Siemens Teamcenter that this BOM structure represents. Links the BOM to its parent product or assembly definition.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Identifier linking this BOM to a specific production version in SAP PP, which combines a BOM with a routing to define a complete manufacturing process. Supports multiple production methods for the same product.

attributes.name: quantity_basis
attributes.description: The base quantity for which this BOM is defined, typically 1 for single-unit BOMs or a batch size for process manufacturing. All component quantities in the BOM structure are expressed relative to this basis.

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Revision level or version identifier for this BOM structure. Tracks engineering changes and ensures traceability across ECO and ECN processes. Critical for change management and configuration control.

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage at the BOM header level, applied to all components. Used in MRP to inflate material requirements. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%).

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The primary key or unique identifier of this BOM record in the source system. Enables bidirectional traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational PLM system.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity basis, such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter). Must align with the PLM item and material master UOM definitions.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Defines the business context in which this BOM is intended to be used. Production for shop floor execution, Costing for standard cost calculation, Engineering for design and development, Maintenance for service and repair, Sales Order for customer-specific configurations, Project for one-time builds.

attributes.name: weight_total
attributes.description: Total weight of the finished assembly including all components, calculated from the BOM structure. Used for logistics planning, freight cost estimation, and product specifications.

attributes.name: weight_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total BOM weight. KG (kilogram), LB (pound), G (gram), OZ (ounce), MT (metric ton).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that originally created this BOM record. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: engineering_bom_line
products.description: Individual line item within a Bill of Materials, representing a single parent-child component relationship. Captures position number, find number, quantity per assembly, unit of measure, reference designator, substitute component references (approved alternates with qualification status and usage restrictions), phantom flag, effectivity start/end dates, and engineering notes. Enables full BOM explosion and implosion queries for MRP, supports alternate sourcing without ECO, and provides the granular structure for production routing and cost rollup.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity representing a single parent-child component relationship within a bill of materials structure.

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the line item to its containing bill of materials assembly structure.

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.bom. Business justification: bom_line represents a line item belonging to a BOM; adding bom_id creates the required parent-child relationship and eliminates the BOM silo.

attributes.name: issue_stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: BOM line items carry a component issue storage location — the specific bin/location from which that component is staged and issued to production. This drives material staging, goods issue routing, and

attributes.name: primary_engineering_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent assembly or product that contains this component. Represents the 'parent' side of the parent-child relationship in the BOM structure.

attributes.name: tertiary_engineering_substitute_component_id
attributes.description: Reference to an approved alternate component that can be used in place of the primary component without requiring an Engineering Change Order (ECO). Enables flexible sourcing and supply chain continuity.

attributes.name: assembly_instruction
attributes.description: Specific instructions for assembling or installing this component into the parent assembly. May reference work instructions, torque specifications, or special tooling requirements.

attributes.name: bulk_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a bulk material (e.g., paint, adhesive, lubricant) that is consumed in variable quantities and may not be tracked at individual unit level.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) number that introduced or last modified this BOM line. Provides traceability to engineering change governance processes.

attributes.name: co_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a co-product or by-product that is produced alongside the main assembly. Co-products have negative quantities in the BOM and represent outputs rather than inputs.

attributes.name: cost_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of this component should be included in the parent assembly cost rollup calculation. Some components (e.g., reference items, tooling) may be excluded from product costing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product functionality, safety, or regulatory compliance. Critical components may require additional quality controls, traceability, or supply chain management.

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this component is no longer effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-out of obsolete components. Null indicates the component is currently effective with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_end
attributes.description: The ending serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Null indicates the component remains effective for all subsequent serial numbers.

attributes.name: effectivity_serial_number_start
attributes.description: The starting serial number of the parent assembly for which this component is effective. Enables serial-number-based effectivity control for mid-production engineering changes.

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this component becomes effective in the parent assembly. Used to manage engineering changes and phase-in of new components without creating new BOM versions.

attributes.name: engineering_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line. Indicates whether the component relationship is currently in use, pending approval, or has been superseded.

attributes.name: engineering_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from engineering regarding special assembly instructions, design considerations, quality requirements, or other technical information relevant to this component usage.

attributes.name: find_number
attributes.description: Reference designator or callout number used to locate this component on engineering drawings, assembly diagrams, and technical documentation. Also known as item number or balloon number.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size. When true, the quantity does not scale with production order quantity (e.g., setup materials, tooling).

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: The specific location or mounting point within the parent assembly where this component is installed. Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: The number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used in production scheduling and material requirements planning (MRP) to ensure timely component availability.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system account that last modified this BOM line record. Used for audit trail and change management purposes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: phantom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a phantom (transient) assembly that is not stocked or tracked in inventory. Phantom items are exploded through to their child components during MRP processing.

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Sequential position or line number of this component within the parent assembly BOM. Used for ordering and identifying components in engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this component is obtained: manufactured in-house (make), purchased from suppliers (buy), transferred from another plant (transfer), or subcontracted to external manufacturers.

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The number of units of this component required to build one unit of the parent assembly. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) calculations and cost rollup.

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific location or function of the component in the assembly (e.g., R1, C5, U3 for electronics; A-01, B-12 for mechanical). Used in assembly instructions and maintenance documentation.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: The revision or version of the component that is specified for use in this assembly. Ensures that the correct component revision is used for manufacturing and quality control.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during assembly or manufacturing. Used to adjust material requirements planning (MRP) calculations to account for normal production losses.

attributes.name: sort_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric value used to control the display order of BOM lines in reports, pick lists, and assembly instructions. Lower values appear first.

attributes.name: substitute_qualification_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the substitute component for use in this assembly. Indicates whether the alternate has passed qualification testing and is approved for production use.

attributes.name: substitute_usage_restriction
attributes.description: Conditions or limitations on when the substitute component may be used (e.g., only for specific customer orders, only when primary is unavailable, geographic restrictions). Ensures proper alternate sourcing governance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the component quantity is expressed (e.g., each, kilogram, meter, liter). Must align with the component material master UOM for accurate MRP and inventory calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|L|ML|M|CM|FT|IN|SET|PAIR|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

Supports DFM analysis input and downstream CAM programming.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_revision. Business justification: A CAD model is associated with a specific engineering revision of its component. attributes.description: Username or identifier of the engineering manager or authority who approved the CAD model for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model was formally approved for release to manufacturing.

attributes.name: authoring_tool
attributes.description: Name of the CAD software application used to create the model (e.g., Siemens NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, AutoCAD).

attributes.name: authoring_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CAD authoring software used to create or last modify the model, critical for file compatibility and migration planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_height
attributes.description: Maximum height dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_length
attributes.description: Maximum length dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: bounding_box_width
attributes.description: Maximum width dimension of the CAD model bounding box, used for spatial analysis and packaging planning.

attributes.name: cam_program_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the associated CAM toolpath program generated from this CAD model for CNC machining operations.

attributes.name: cam_programming_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this CAD model requires CAM toolpath programming for CNC machining or other automated manufacturing processes.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_x
attributes.description: X-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_y
attributes.description: Y-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: center_of_gravity_z
attributes.description: Z-coordinate of the calculated center of gravity for the 3D model, used for balance and assembly analysis.

attributes.name: checksum_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the CAD file content, used for integrity verification and change detection.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CAD model record was first created in the PLM system.

attributes.name: dataset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CAD dataset indicating whether it is a 3D solid model, 2D drawing, assembly, simulation file, or CAM toolpath file.

products.name: eco
products.description: Engineering Change Order — the formal governance record initiating, tracking, approving, and closing a controlled change to a released product design. Captures ECO number, change type (design, material, process), priority, reason code, affected items with disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, retrofit), effectivity date, cost/schedule impact, initiator, approver chain, closure status, and revision transition (from/to). Includes affected item detail: item reference, type, current/proposed revision, disposition action, quantity affected, and implementation status per item. Upon approval, also serves as the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) — the formal communication record distributed to production, supply chain, quality, and supplier portals capturing notification distribution list, acknowledgement tracking, implementation date, and affected BOM/drawing revisions. SSOT for engineering change governance and change communication per ISO 9001 change control requirements.

products.name: eco_affected_item
products.description: This association product represents the formal Affected Item record within an Engineering Change Order — the operational junction between an ECO and each component it governs. Each record documents exactly what change is being made to one specific component under one specific ECO, including the disposition action (use-as-is, rework, scrap, retrofit), the revision transition (from/to), the effectivity date for that component, and the quantity affected. This is the SSOT for per-component change disposition and revision tracking within the engineering change control process, per ISO 9001 change control requirements.. Existence Justification: In PLM and manufacturing engineering change management, one ECO formally affects multiple components (parts, sub-assemblies, raw materials), and one component accumulates multiple ECOs over its lifecycle as designs evolve. This is a universally recognized operational business entity called an 'Affected Item' or 'ECO Line Item' — engineers actively create, update, and close these records as part of the change control process, and each record carries disposition, effectivity, and revision transition data that belongs exclusively to the ECO-component pairing, not to either parent entity alone.

Values: use_as_is (existing stock acceptable), rework (modify to new spec), scrap (destroy non-conforming stock), retrofit (field upgrade required). This is a per-component value that belongs to the association, not the ECO header.

products.name: ncr
products.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) serving as the single, unified quality event record for ALL deviations from specifications, standards, or requirements regardless of detection source or reporting channel. Encompasses internal defects, customer complaints (including 8D problem-solving), supplier non-conformances, field returns/RMA dispositions, and audit-triggered findings. Captures non-conformance type (internal/customer/supplier/field-return/audit), affected material/product/serial number, detection source (incoming inspection, in-process, final inspection, field/customer, audit, supplier delivery), severity classification, containment actions, root cause analysis, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return-to-supplier, repair, replace, credit, no-fault-found), RMA tracking fields (return authorization number, customer reference, repair actions, return shipment status), SAP QM notification type mapping (Q1/Q2/Q3), and linkage to CAPA for corrective/preventive action. Supports 8D methodology for customer-facing issues. Aligned with ISO 9001 clause 8.7 (control of nonconforming outputs), clause 10.2 (corrective action), and integrates with Salesforce Service Cloud for customer-originated events.
