attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the customer complaint record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record created to address the root cause of this complaint. Links complaint to the CAPA management process.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Customer complaints about product failures must trace to component design for root cause analysis. Engineering needs 'all field complaints linked to this component' to drive design improvements and DF

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contact person at the customer organization who reported the complaint.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account (OEM, distributor, or end user) who submitted the complaint. Links to the customer domain.

attributes.name: delivery_note_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.delivery_note. Business justification: Customer complaint resolution process: complaints about wrong items, damaged goods, or packing errors require the delivery note for picking/packing/goods-issue details. Delivery note provides granular

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment_register. Business justification: Customer complaints frequently trace to a specific production machine (defective tooling, out-of-calibration equipment). Linking complaint to equipment_register supports 8D root cause investigation an

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Customer complaint resolution requires direct traceability to the originating sales order for credit memo issuance, replacement order creation, and order-level defect rate reporting. customer_order_nu

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Customer complaints in manufacturing routinely trigger credit notes or debit note invoices (warranty claims, returned goods, quality deductions). The complaint record must reference the disputed invoi

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Links complaints to the precise order line, enabling root‑cause analysis and targeted corrective actions.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Customer complaints reference specific batches for recall management, warranty analysis, and field failure traceability. affected_batch_number is a denormalized reference replaced by this FK. Direct l

attributes.name: ncr_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.ncr. Business justification: Customer Complaint may stem from an NCR; link complaint to NCR for traceability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Customer complaints are attributed to the manufacturing plant that produced the defective product — plant-level complaint rate KPIs are a standard quality management report. plant_code is a denormaliz

attributes.name: production_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_work_order. Business justification: Customer complaints must be traceable to the production work order that manufactured the defective product — essential for warranty cost allocation, production quality traceability, and 8D root cause

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_rma. Business justification: Customer complaints for defective or wrong goods trigger RMA authorizations. rma_number is a denormalized text field on customer_complaint. Direct FK enables complaint-to-RMA workflow automation, cred

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Customer complaint resolution in manufacturing is governed by the sales contract's warranty_terms, sla_resolution_time_hours, and penalty_clause. Linking customer_complaint to sales_contract enables S

attributes.name: sales_order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Complaints are investigated against the exact order intake that generated the sale, supporting root‑cause analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Customer complaint investigations require the originating shipment to assess handling, used in the Complaint Root‑Cause Analysis report.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Customer complaints reference the affected product SKU; FK enables complaint analysis and warranty reporting per SKU.

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_agreement. Business justification: Customer complaints in manufacturing are resolved under the governing SLA agreement, which defines response time targets, resolution deadlines, and penalty clauses. SLA compliance reporting and penalt

attributes.name: affected_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific unit reported in the complaint. Enables unit-level traceability through manufacturing, shipping, and field service records.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the complaint was formally closed following customer acceptance of the resolution and verification of corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer complaint including observed symptoms, conditions of failure, and customer-reported impact. Corresponds to SAP QM QN Problem Description field.

attributes.name: complaint_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable complaint reference number used in customer communications and SAP QM Quality Notification (QN). Format: CC-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: complaint_source
attributes.description: Origin channel or party type from which the complaint was received. Supports segmentation of complaint volumes by customer tier.

attributes.name: complaint_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the complaint record. Drives escalation, SLA tracking, and reporting. 'pending_customer' indicates awaiting customer feedback or approval.

attributes.name: complaint_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable summary title of the complaint as entered by the quality engineer or service representative. Used in dashboards and notification emails.

attributes.name: complaint_type
attributes.description: Categorization of the complaint by nature of the issue. Used for trend analysis, routing, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_defect|field_failure|delivery_issue|documentation_error|safety_concern|performance_deviation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: containment_action
attributes.description: Immediate containment action taken to prevent further defective product from reaching the customer, corresponding to Step D3 of the 8D problem-solving methodology. Includes field holds, sorting, or shipment stops.

attributes.name: containment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the containment action was implemented. Used to measure response speed and SLA compliance for initial containment.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the permanent corrective action was fully implemented and verified effective.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the permanent corrective action selected and implemented to eliminate the root cause, corresponding to 8D Steps D5 (select) and D6 (implement). May trigger an Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN).

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the permanent corrective action must be implemented and verified. Used for SLA tracking and escalation management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this complaint record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Status of the customer's acceptance of the proposed resolution or 8D corrective action response. Determines whether the complaint can be formally closed.

attributes.name: customer_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal response (e.g., 8D report, corrective action plan) was communicated to the customer. Used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: defect_location
attributes.description: Physical location or component area on the product where the defect or failure was observed. Supports PFMEA and design engineering root cause analysis.

attributes.name: eight_d_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report issued to the customer. Required by many OEM customers as part of complaint resolution documentation.

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code from the quality defect code catalog identifying the failure mode. Used for statistical analysis and SPC trending. Corresponds to SAP QM defect code.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Specific manner in which the product or component failed as identified during complaint investigation. Aligned with FMEA failure mode taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for standardized failure mode codes]

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., OSHA, EPA, UL, CE Marking body). Triggers compliance workflow and documentation requirements.

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint involves a potential safety hazard to personnel or end users. Triggers mandatory escalation to product safety and regulatory teams per OSHA and CE Marking requirements.

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Description of systemic preventive actions taken to prevent recurrence of similar complaints across other products or processes, corresponding to 8D Step D7.

attributes.name: quantity_complained
attributes.description: Number of units reported as defective or non-conforming in the complaint. Used for severity assessment and potential recall scope estimation.

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: Number of units physically returned by the customer under a Return Material Authorization (RMA). May differ from quantity complained if partial returns occur.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the complaint was received and logged in the system. Used for SLA response-time measurement.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally reported or submitted the complaint. Used as the principal business event date for SLA and aging calculations.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Type of resolution provided to the customer. Drives financial impact tracking (credit notes, replacements) and customer satisfaction measurement.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category of the identified root cause. Enables Pareto analysis of complaint drivers across design, process, material, and supplier dimensions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: design|process|material|supplier|handling|measurement|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the verified root cause of the complaint, corresponding to Step D4 of the 8D methodology. May reference 5-Why analysis, fishbone diagram, or PFMEA findings.

attributes.name: salesforce_case_number
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier from Salesforce Service Cloud case record linked to this complaint, enabling traceability between CRM and quality management systems.

attributes.name: sap_qn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Quality Management (QM) Quality Notification (QN) Number
attributes.description: SAP QM Quality Notification number corresponding to this complaint, used for traceability within SAP S/4HANA QM module.

tag_set.value: SAP Quality Management (QM) Quality Notification (QN) Number

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the complaint based on customer impact, safety risk, and regulatory implications. Drives escalation rules and response SLA targets. Aligned with FMEA severity ranking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this complaint record.

products.name: inspection_characteristic
products.description: Master reference table for inspection_characteristic. Referenced by characteristic_id.

attributes.name: inspection_characteristic_id
attributes.description: Primary key for inspection_characteristic

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_specification. Business justification: Inspection characteristics (tolerances, spec limits) are derived directly from engineering specifications. Linking enables traceability from 'what we measure' to 'what engineering specified' — a manda

attributes.name: parent_inspection_characteristic_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on inspection_characteristic (parent_inspection_characteristic_id)

attributes.name: characteristic_type
attributes.description: Category of the characteristic indicating the nature of the measurement.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned by engineering to identify the characteristic across systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the characteristic record was first created.

attributes.name: criticality_level
attributes.description: Impact level of the characteristic on product quality and compliance.

attributes.name: data_collection_system
attributes.description: System that records the measurement data (e.g., MES, PLC, manual log).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the characteristic measures and why it is important.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the characteristic becomes valid for use.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the characteristic is retired or superseded (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: frequency_per_shift
attributes.description: Number of times this characteristic is inspected each production shift.

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: Method used to capture the characteristic (e.g., manual, automated sensor).

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the characteristic must be inspected for every unit.

attributes.name: is_statistical_process_control
attributes.description: True if the characteristic is used in SPC calculations (Cp/Cpk).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current status of the characteristic definition.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure used for the characteristic (e.g., mm, °C, psi).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the inspection characteristic used in reports and work instructions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form field for any supplemental information or remarks.

attributes.name: sampling_plan
attributes.description: Definition of the sampling approach (e.g., 1‑in‑5, 100% inspection).

attributes.name: spec_source
attributes.description: Origin of the specification limits for the characteristic.

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: Allowed deviation from the target value, expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the characteristic record.

domains.name: asset
domains.description: Equipment and asset lifecycle management domain tracking physical assets, machinery maintenance (CMMS), preventive maintenance scheduling, TPM, work order execution, MTBF/MTTR analysis, downtime events, spare parts, condition monitoring, and CapEx asset registers via Maximo. Manages production equipment, PLCs, CNC machines, robotics, and facility infrastructure.

products.name: equipment_register
products.description: Master record of all physical assets and production equipment in the CapEx asset register, including CNC machines, PLCs, robotics, conveyors, HVAC, and facility infrastructure. Serves as the SSOT for equipment identity, classification, parent-child hierarchy (structural decomposition into sub-assemblies and components), installation details, manufacturer specifications, commissioning date, depreciation method, book value, current operational status, criticality ranking, and location assignment history (including transfer/relocation audit trail with origin, destination, reason, condition at transfer, and authorization reference). Sourced from Maximo Asset Management and SAP S/4HANA PM module.
products.reference: Maximo Asset / SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: equipment_register_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment record in the CapEx asset register. Primary key for the equipment_register data product.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Equipment registers represent physical assets that ARE engineering components (motors, pumps, sensors). Linking enables ECO impact assessment on installed assets, MTBF-by-component-type reporting, and

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.drawing. Business justification: Regulatory audit requires each equipment to reference its engineering drawing for compliance verification.

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.specification. Business justification: Quality control tracks equipment against its engineering specification to ensure performance and safety standards.

attributes.name: inbound_delivery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.inbound_delivery. Business justification: Asset commissioning process: new equipment arrives via inbound delivery; linking equipment_register to its inbound_delivery supports goods receipt verification, warranty start date confirmation, and a

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.location. Business justification: Every physical asset in a CMMS must be placed at a specific location in the plant hierarchy. equipment_register currently stores functional_location as a free-text STRING, which is denormalized. Addin

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Capital asset procurement references a material master record; the link supports cost, valuation, and purchase‑order reporting across asset and inventory modules.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Asset accounting, depreciation, and regulatory compliance require equipment assets assigned to a plant. Plant-level asset registers are mandatory for financial reporting (IFRS 16, fixed asset accounti

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Equipment assets are covered by OEM service contracts or maintenance agreements. Linking equipment to its governing service contract enables warranty tracking, contract compliance audits, and ensures

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_line. Business justification: Asset management and maintenance impact analysis require knowing which production line each equipment asset belongs to. Shutdown planning, OEE impact assessment, and asset replacement decisions all de

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_agreement. Business justification: Individual equipment items are covered under specific SLA agreements (covered_asset_count, uptime_target_pct, spare_parts_included). Linking equipment to its governing SLA is essential for maintenance

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_location. Business justification: Business process: Asset Receiving & Storage requires tracking which warehouse bin new equipment is stored in before installation, enabling inventory valuation and location reporting.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: Broad category grouping for the asset used in CapEx asset register classification, depreciation policy assignment, and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP fixed asset schedules.
attributes.value_regex: Production Equipment|Facility Infrastructure|Utility System|Safety System|Measurement and Test Equipment|IT and Automation

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique asset tag or equipment number assigned in the CapEx asset register and stamped on the physical asset. Corresponds to the Maximo Asset Number and SAP S/4HANA Equipment Number (PM module). Serves as the primary business identifier for cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated capacity value (e.g., 'units/hr', 'kg/hr', 'tonnes/day', 'cycles/min'). Required to correctly interpret and compare capacity figures across heterogeneous equipment types.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was formally commissioned and placed into productive service following installation and acceptance testing. Marks the start of the asset's operational lifecycle and triggers depreciation commencement in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: condition_at_transfer
attributes.description: Recorded physical condition grade of the equipment at the time of its most recent transfer or relocation. Provides a point-in-time condition snapshot for the location assignment history audit trail and insurance/liability documentation.

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment grade of the equipment based on the most recent inspection or condition monitoring evaluation. Used in asset lifecycle management decisions (repair vs. replace), maintenance prioritization, and insurance assessments.

attributes.name: criticality_ranking
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of the equipment based on its impact on production throughput, safety, and quality if it fails. Critical assets receive priority maintenance resources and are included in TPM and FMEA programs. Used in maintenance strategy selection and spare parts stocking decisions.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this equipment record (acquisition cost, book value, replacement value). Supports multi-currency CapEx reporting for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was formally decommissioned and removed from productive service. Triggers asset write-off or disposal processing in SAP FI-AA. Null for active assets.

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the equipment type used for asset categorization, maintenance strategy assignment, and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CNC Machine|PLC|Robotics|Conveyor|HVAC|Compressor|Pump|Electrical Panel|Facility Infrastructure|Inspection Equipment — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the equipment or asset (e.g., 'CNC Milling Machine #3', 'Conveyor Belt Line A'). Used as the primary identity label for display in reports, dashboards, and work orders.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was physically installed at its designated location. May precede commissioning date if acceptance testing or qualification activities are required before productive use.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal inspection or condition assessment performed on the equipment. Used to track regulatory inspection compliance intervals and condition monitoring schedules.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent completed maintenance activity (preventive or corrective) was performed on the equipment. Used to calculate maintenance intervals, overdue PM alerts, and MTBF analysis.

attributes.name: last_transfer_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent location transfer or relocation of the equipment. Part of the location assignment history audit trail tracking asset movements between plants, production lines, or storage areas.

attributes.name: last_transfer_destination
attributes.description: Functional location or plant code to which the equipment was most recently transferred. Provides the destination leg of the location transfer audit trail for asset movement traceability.

attributes.name: last_transfer_origin
attributes.description: Functional location or plant code from which the equipment was most recently transferred. Provides the origin leg of the location transfer audit trail for asset movement traceability.

attributes.name: last_transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code for the most recent equipment relocation or transfer. Part of the location assignment history audit trail required for asset tracking compliance and CapEx asset register accuracy.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Assigned maintenance approach for the equipment as defined in the Maximo CMMS and SAP PM maintenance plan. Drives scheduling of preventive maintenance (PM) work orders, TPM activities, and condition monitoring programs.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was manufactured by the OEM. Used to calculate equipment age, assess remaining useful life, and determine warranty expiry.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) who produced the asset (e.g., Siemens, Fanuc, ABB, Bosch Rexroth). Used for warranty management, spare parts sourcing, and OEM service contract administration.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures
attributes.description: Average elapsed time in hours between successive equipment failures, calculated from historical work order and downtime event data. Key reliability KPI used in TPM programs, maintenance strategy optimization, and OEE analysis. Expressed in hours.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair
attributes.description: Average elapsed time in hours required to restore the equipment to operational status following a failure, calculated from historical corrective maintenance work orders. Key maintainability KPI used in TPM and SLA management. Expressed in hours.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: OEM-assigned model or part number for the equipment. Used for spare parts procurement, technical documentation lookup, and warranty claims.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned preventive maintenance activity on the equipment, as calculated by the maintenance plan in SAP PM or Maximo. Drives work order generation and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the equipment. Drives maintenance scheduling, OEE calculations, and asset availability reporting. 'In Service' indicates active production use; 'Decommissioned' triggers asset write-off in SAP FI-AA.

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Nominal electrical power consumption rating of the equipment in kilowatts as specified by the OEM. Used for energy management planning, ISO 50001 energy audits, electrical load balancing, and CapEx infrastructure sizing.

attributes.name: rated_capacity
attributes.description: OEM-specified nominal production capacity or throughput rating of the equipment (e.g., units per hour, tonnes per day). Serves as the denominator for OEE availability and performance calculations and production planning in APS.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the equipment record was first created in the master data system (Maximo or SAP S/4HANA). Provides the record creation audit trail for data governance and MDM lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the equipment record in the master data system. Used for change detection, data synchronization between Maximo and SAP, and MDM data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: regulatory_certification
attributes.description: Applicable regulatory certifications and compliance markings held by the equipment (e.g., CE Marking, UL Listed, CSA, ATEX). Required for legal operation in specific jurisdictions and customer delivery compliance. Multiple certifications stored as comma-separated values.

attributes.name: replacement_value
attributes.description: Current estimated cost to replace the equipment with an equivalent new asset. Used for insurance valuation, CapEx planning, and asset renewal decision-making. Updated periodically based on market pricing.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety classification of the equipment based on occupational health and safety risk profile. Determines required safety permits, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, PPE requirements, and regulatory inspection schedules under OSHA and ISO 45001.
attributes.value_regex: Hazardous|Non-Hazardous|Pressure Vessel|Electrical High Voltage|Confined Space|Radiation Source

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the specific equipment unit. Used for warranty registration, OEM service calls, and regulatory compliance traceability. Classified as confidential device identifier.

attributes.name: transfer_authorization_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the authorization document (e.g., work order, change request, or management approval) that sanctioned the most recent equipment transfer or relocation. Provides the authorization audit trail for asset movement governance.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM or supplier warranty for the equipment expires. Used to trigger preventive maintenance strategy transitions from warranty-covered to self-maintained, and to initiate extended warranty negotiations.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Physical weight of the equipment in kilograms as specified by the OEM. Used for facility floor load planning, rigging and relocation logistics, and transportation planning during asset transfers.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP PP/PM work center code associated with the equipment, linking it to production routing and capacity planning. Enables integration between asset management and production scheduling in SAP S/4HANA.

products.name: location
products.description: Hierarchical location structure for physical asset placement, covering plant, building, floor, production line, work center, and exact bay/cell coordinates with optional GIS/GPS reference points. Tracks functional location hierarchy per Maximo FL structure and IEC 81346 reference designation system, enabling spatial queries for maintenance routing, safety zone mapping, environmental zone classification (ATEX zones, clean rooms), and OEE analysis by location. Serves as the SSOT for where assets can be installed and the physical topology of the manufacturing facility.
products.reference: Maximo Functional Location / SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset location record in the Maximo Functional Location (FL) hierarchy. Serves as the primary key for the asset_location data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: parent_location_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent location in the functional location hierarchy. Enables recursive traversal of the plant topology from site level down to individual bay/cell coordinates. Null for top-level (plant/site) locations.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Functional location hierarchies in EAM systems (SAP PM, Maximo) require locations assigned to plants for maintenance planning group assignment, cost center allocation, and plant-level safety complianc

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_project. Business justification: Project asset management assigns physical locations to engineering projects for planning and reporting.

attributes.name: transport_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.transport_route. Business justification: Route Planning process uses a default transport route per location to generate shipment schedules and cost estimates.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the facility or plant location. Used for regulatory reporting, logistics coordination, emergency services, and legal documentation. Classified as confidential organizational address data.

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Physical floor area of the location in square metres. Used for capacity planning, safety zone sizing, equipment layout design, and facility management reporting. Represents the principal quantitative measurement of the location resource.

attributes.name: atex_zone_classification
attributes.description: Explosive atmosphere zone classification per ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU and IEC 60079 standard (e.g., Zone 0, Zone 1, Zone 2 for gas/vapour; Zone 20, Zone 21, Zone 22 for dust). Mandatory for equipment selection, safety inspections, and regulatory compliance in hazardous areas. Null if location is not classified as hazardous.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific building or structure within the plant site where this location resides (e.g., 'BLD-A', 'HALL-3'). Used for maintenance routing, emergency response planning, and facility management.

attributes.name: capex_asset_register_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Fixed Asset Accounting) asset register code associated with this location for CapEx tracking, depreciation calculation, and balance sheet reporting. Links the physical location to the financial asset register per IFRS/GAAP fixed asset accounting standards.

attributes.name: ceiling_height_m
attributes.description: Clear ceiling height at this location in metres. Determines suitability for tall equipment installation (e.g., overhead cranes, tall CNC machines, robotic gantries), forklift operation clearance, and ventilation system design.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the facility location is situated. Used for regulatory reporting, tax jurisdiction determination, logistics routing, and multi-site geographic analytics.

attributes.name: clean_room_classification
attributes.description: ISO 14644-1 clean room classification for controlled environment locations (ISO 1 through ISO 9, representing particle count per cubic metre). Governs equipment installation requirements, personnel access protocols, and environmental monitoring for precision manufacturing, electronics assembly, or pharmaceutical-adjacent processes. Null if not a controlled environment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where this location is situated (e.g., 'DEU', 'USA', 'CHN'). Drives regulatory compliance framework selection (CE marking, OSHA, EPA), tax jurisdiction, and multi-national OEE benchmarking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset location record was first created in the system (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Provides audit trail for data governance, MDM lineage tracking via Informatica MDM, and compliance with ISO 9001 record control requirements.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed description of the asset location including physical characteristics, operational context, special conditions, and any relevant notes for maintenance technicians (e.g., 'North-east corner of Building A, adjacent to emergency exit 3, high-vibration environment due to press operations').

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this location record became operationally active and valid for asset installation and maintenance work order assignment. Supports temporal validity tracking for location hierarchy changes, plant expansions, and decommissioning events.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this location record ceases to be operationally valid (e.g., due to decommissioning, demolition, or restructuring). Null for currently active locations. Enables historical analysis of plant topology changes and supports CapEx asset retirement workflows.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the location above mean sea level in metres (WGS84). Used for environmental zone classification, flood risk assessment, HVAC system design, and precision asset installation requirements in multi-storey or outdoor facilities.

attributes.name: energy_zone_code
attributes.description: Energy management zone code assigned to this location per ISO 50001 energy management system. Groups locations into energy monitoring boundaries for sub-metering, energy consumption reporting, and energy efficiency KPI calculation by production area.

attributes.name: environmental_zone_code
attributes.description: Environmental monitoring zone code per ISO 14001 environmental management system. Groups locations for emissions monitoring, waste management tracking, and environmental compliance reporting to EPA and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: fire_zone_code
attributes.description: Fire compartment or zone code assigned to this location per fire safety regulations and building codes (e.g., 'FZ-A1', 'COMP-03'). Used for fire suppression system mapping, emergency response planning, and compliance with NFPA and local fire codes.

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Identifier for the floor or level within a building where this location is situated (e.g., 'G', '1', '2', 'B1', 'MEZZANINE'). Supports maintenance technician routing, emergency evacuation planning, and vertical spatial queries.

attributes.name: functional_location_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the functional location per Maximo FL structure and IEC 81346 reference designation system (e.g., PLT01-BLD02-FL03-WC04). Used as the primary business identifier for spatial referencing, maintenance routing, and asset installation tracking.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this location within the functional location hierarchy (1 = plant/site, 2 = building/area, 3 = floor/zone, 4 = production line, 5 = work center, 6 = bay/cell). Enables hierarchical rollup queries for OEE analysis, maintenance cost aggregation, and spatial reporting.

attributes.name: iec_reference_designation
attributes.description: Structured reference designation code per IEC 81346 standard for industrial systems (e.g., '=A1+B2-C3'). Provides internationally standardized identification of the location within the technical system hierarchy, enabling interoperability with engineering documentation, CAD/CAM systems, and PLM.

attributes.name: installed_asset_count
attributes.description: Current count of physical assets installed at this location as recorded in Maximo. Provides a snapshot of location utilization density for capacity planning, maintenance workload estimation, and facility layout optimization. Updated by the asset installation/deinstallation process.

attributes.name: is_outdoor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is an outdoor or open-air area (True) versus an enclosed indoor facility (False). Determines weatherproofing requirements for installed assets, IP rating specifications for equipment, and applicable environmental protection standards.

attributes.name: is_restricted_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location requires special authorization, permits, or PPE for personnel access (True) beyond standard plant access controls. Drives access management workflows, permit-to-work systems, and safety induction requirements for maintenance technicians.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this asset location record (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Supports change detection for ETL incremental loads, audit trail maintenance, and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the asset location for GIS-based spatial queries, maintenance technician navigation, and facility mapping. Applicable primarily to outdoor locations, large plant areas, or when GPS-enabled asset tracking is deployed.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset location indicating whether it is operationally active, temporarily inactive, decommissioned, under construction, or reserved for future use. Controls whether assets can be installed at this location and whether maintenance work orders can be raised against it.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the location within the facility hierarchy (e.g., plant, building, floor, production_line, work_center, bay, cell). Drives hierarchy navigation, maintenance routing logic, and spatial analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: plant|building|floor|production_line|work_center|bay|cell|storage_area|utility_room|outdoor_area — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the asset location for GIS-based spatial queries, maintenance technician navigation, and facility mapping. Applicable primarily to outdoor locations, large plant areas, or when GPS-enabled asset tracking is deployed.

attributes.name: maintenance_planner_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA PM or Maximo planner group code responsible for planning and scheduling preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance work orders at this location. Drives maintenance routing, resource allocation, and TPM scheduling.

attributes.name: maintenance_work_center
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA PM maintenance work center responsible for executing maintenance activities at this location. Distinct from the production work center; this identifies the maintenance crew or workshop assigned for TPM, corrective maintenance, and breakdown response.

attributes.name: max_asset_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of assets that can be physically installed at this location based on space, power, and structural constraints. Used for capacity planning, CapEx project scoping, and facility layout design to prevent over-installation.

attributes.name: max_load_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum permissible floor or structural load capacity at this location in kilograms. Critical for equipment installation planning, CapEx asset placement decisions, and structural safety compliance. Prevents overloading of floors, platforms, or mezzanines during asset installation.

attributes.name: maximo_location_code
attributes.description: Native location identifier from IBM Maximo Asset Management system (LOCATIONS.LOCATION field). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the Maximo CMMS source of record for work order routing and preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the asset location (e.g., 'Assembly Line 3 - Bay 7', 'CNC Machining Cell A'). Used in maintenance work orders, safety documentation, and OEE reporting to identify the physical location clearly.

attributes.name: network_segment
attributes.description: Industrial network segment or VLAN identifier assigned to this location for IIoT device connectivity, SCADA/DCS integration, and PLC communication (e.g., 'OT-ZONE-A', 'SCADA-NET-02'). Supports IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity zone and conduit model for network segmentation compliance.

attributes.name: pm_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of preventive maintenance scheduling strategy applied to assets at this location (time_based, usage_based, condition_based, or none). Supports TPM strategy configuration, maintenance planning in Maximo, and predictive maintenance analytics.

attributes.name: power_supply_type
attributes.description: Primary electrical power supply specification available at this location (e.g., AC_220V, AC_480V, DC_24V). Governs equipment compatibility for asset installation, PLC and CNC machine power requirements, and electrical safety compliance per IEC 61131 and NEC standards.

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production line associated with this location (e.g., 'LINE-01', 'ASSY-B'). Links the physical location to production scheduling, OEE measurement, and Siemens Opcenter MES work center definitions for throughput and cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: safety_zone_type
attributes.description: Safety zone designation for the location per OSHA and ISO 45001 requirements (e.g., general access, restricted, exclusion zone, emergency assembly point, fire zone, chemical storage). Drives access control, PPE requirements, and emergency response planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general|restricted|exclusion|emergency_assembly|fire_zone|chemical_storage — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the manufacturing site or plant to which this location belongs (e.g., 'PLT01', 'SITE-DE-01'). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA Plant code (MM/PM module) and Maximo site identifier for cross-system integration and multi-site OEE benchmarking.

attributes.name: site_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the manufacturing site or plant (e.g., 'Stuttgart Automation Plant', 'Detroit Assembly Facility'). Used in reporting, safety documentation, and regulatory submissions to identify the physical facility.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the location (e.g., 'Europe/Berlin', 'America/Detroit'). Critical for accurate timestamp interpretation of SCADA/MES events, shift scheduling, maintenance work order timing, and cross-site production reporting across time zones.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA or Opcenter MES work center code associated with this functional location. Enables direct linkage between the physical location and production planning, capacity scheduling, and cost center allocation for manufacturing execution analysis.

products.name: asset_work_order
products.description: Maintenance work order record capturing all maintenance activity types executed against equipment assets: corrective, preventive, predictive, condition-based, emergency, and shutdown/turnaround maintenance. Tracks work order type, priority, TPM pillar classification, originating failure code, assigned craft/trade, planned vs actual labor hours, planned vs actual material costs, spare parts reserved and consumed (part number, quantity, issue date, cost), start/finish dates, downtime duration, and completion status. For shutdown-type work orders, additionally captures scope of work summary, affected production lines, shutdown coordinator, planned start/end dates, and estimated total cost. Core transactional entity sourced from Maximo Work Management module and SAP PM orders. Serves as the SSOT for all maintenance execution activity.
products.reference: Maximo Work Order / SAP PM Order

attributes.name: asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the maintenance work order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_contact. Business justification: Work orders in field service manufacturing require a named customer contact (site representative or technical_contact_flag) for work approval, access coordination, and sign-off. Linking to customer_co

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Work Order Billing & SLA: associates work orders with the requesting customer to allocate costs and measure SLA performance per account.

attributes.name: ecn_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecn. Business justification: ECNs frequently trigger field retrofit work orders to modify installed equipment to the new revision. Linking asset_work_order to ecn enables ECN implementation tracking, closure verification (all aff

attributes.name: job_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance plan or strategy record under which this work order was generated. Links to the strategic maintenance plan defining the maintenance approach for the asset class.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_line. Business justification: Required for Order‑to‑Production Allocation report linking each work order to the sales order line it fulfills.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional location or plant area where the asset resides and the maintenance work is performed (e.g., production line, bay, building). Corresponds to LOCATION in Maximo and Functional Location in SAP PM.

attributes.name: order_intake_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_intake. Business justification: Installation, commissioning, and field-service work orders must reference the originating sales order intake for billing reconciliation, warranty-start-date determination, and customer handoff reporti

attributes.name: parent_work_order_asset_work_order_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier linking this work order to a parent work order, used for shutdown/turnaround scope decomposition or hierarchical work order structures. Null for top-level work orders.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.plant. Business justification: Maintenance work orders are plant-specific for cost center allocation, regulatory compliance reporting, and plant-level maintenance KPI dashboards. Plant assignment is mandatory for multi-plant ERP ma

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Outsourced maintenance work orders must reference the governing service contract for SLA compliance reporting, billing validation, and contract utilization tracking. Standard requirement for contracte

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_project. Business justification: Work orders are cost‑tracked and reported under the engineering project that originated the change.

attributes.name: revision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.revision. Business justification: Implementation work orders must reference the specific engineering revision they are executing (ECO/ECN driven change).

attributes.name: rma_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_rma. Business justification: RMA-triggered repair work order process: when a customer returns a defective item, a repair/rework work order is raised against the RMA. Manufacturing MRO operations require traceability from the repa

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shift. Business justification: Maintenance work orders are executed during specific shifts for labor cost allocation, shift handover documentation, and shift-based maintenance performance reporting. TPM shift-based maintenance metr

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_agreement. Business justification: Work orders executed under a service contract must reference the SLA agreement to enforce response time SLAs (initial_response_time_hours), track field service visits against max_annual_service_visits

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: Actual date and time when maintenance execution was completed and the asset was returned to service. Used for MTTR calculation, downtime reporting, and OEE analysis.

attributes.name: actual_labor_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost of labor incurred for executing this work order, calculated from actual labor hours and applicable craft rates. Used for total maintenance cost reporting and OpEx analysis.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours actually expended by all technicians in executing this work order. Captured from time reporting in Maximo or Workday. Used for cost variance analysis and workforce productivity reporting.

attributes.name: actual_material_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost of spare parts and materials consumed during execution of this work order, in the local operating currency. Sourced from inventory issue transactions in Maximo/SAP MM. Used for maintenance cost variance and OpEx reporting.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date and time when maintenance execution commenced on this work order. Captured by the technician via MES or Maximo mobile. Used for MTTR calculation and schedule adherence analysis.

attributes.name: affected_production_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of production lines impacted by this work order's execution. Applicable primarily for shutdown/turnaround and emergency work orders. Used for production scheduling coordination.

attributes.name: asset_criticality
attributes.description: Criticality classification of the asset at the time this work order was created, indicating the business impact of asset failure. Drives maintenance prioritization and resource allocation. Derived from the asset master criticality assessment.

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.description: Financial classification of the work order costs as either Capital Expenditure (CapEx) for asset improvements/replacements or Operational Expenditure (OpEx) for routine maintenance and repairs. Critical for financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: completion_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the outcome or resolution of the work order upon completion (e.g., repaired, replaced, adjusted, no fault found, deferred). Used for failure analysis and maintenance effectiveness reporting. Corresponds to ACTFINISH resolution codes in Maximo.

attributes.name: completion_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text technician notes documenting the work performed, findings, parts replaced, and any follow-up actions recommended upon work order completion. Captured in Maximo WORKLOG or SAP PM notification.

attributes.name: craft_type
attributes.description: The maintenance craft or trade skill classification required and assigned to execute this work order (e.g., Electrician, Millwright, Instrumentation Technician, Welder, Pipefitter). Corresponds to CRAFT in Maximo Labor records.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work order record was first captured in the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary cost fields on this work order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency reporting for global manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: downtime_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total production downtime in hours caused by the failure or maintenance activity associated with this work order. Core input for OEE availability calculation and MTTR analysis. Null if the work order did not cause production downtime.

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized failure classification code identifying the root cause or failure mode that originated this work order. Used for FMEA analysis, MTBF/MTTR trending, and CAPA tracking. Corresponds to FAILURECODE in Maximo and Cause Code in SAP PM.

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the observed failure, fault symptom, or maintenance trigger that initiated this work order. Captured by the originating technician or operator at time of request.

attributes.name: is_production_impacting
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work order caused or required a production stoppage or capacity reduction. True = production was impacted; False = maintenance performed without production impact (e.g., running maintenance). Key filter for OEE and availability reporting.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the scope of work, maintenance instructions, safety precautions, and special requirements for executing this work order. Corresponds to LDTEXT in Maximo.

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any Non-Conformance Report (NCR) or CAPA record linked to this work order, where the maintenance activity was triggered by or resulted in a quality non-conformance event.

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when execution of this work order is planned to be completed. Used for production downtime planning and resource scheduling. Corresponds to SCHEDFINISH in Maximo.

attributes.name: planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours estimated and planned for executing this work order across all assigned crafts. Used for resource capacity planning, scheduling, and budget estimation. Corresponds to ESTLABHRS in Maximo.

attributes.name: planned_material_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of spare parts and materials planned for this work order, in the local operating currency. Used for maintenance budget planning and CapEx/OpEx classification. Corresponds to ESTMATCOST in Maximo.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when execution of this work order is planned to begin. Used for maintenance scheduling, resource planning, and production coordination. Corresponds to SCHEDSTART in Maximo.

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preventive maintenance schedule master record that generated this work order, if applicable. Null for corrective or emergency work orders. Corresponds to PM record in Maximo.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking assigned to the work order indicating urgency and scheduling precedence. Priority 1 (Emergency) requires immediate response; Priority 5 (Low) is deferred maintenance. Drives scheduling in APS and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date and time when the maintenance need was first reported or the work order was created in the source system. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Corresponds to REPORTDATE in Maximo.

attributes.name: safety_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the safety permit (e.g., LOTO permit, hot work permit) issued for this work order. Null if no permit is required. Supports OSHA compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: safety_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety permit (e.g., Lockout/Tagout, hot work permit, confined space entry permit) is required before executing this work order. Drives safety compliance workflow in Maximo. Mandatory for OSHA and ISO 45001 compliance.

attributes.name: shutdown_scope_summary
attributes.description: For shutdown or turnaround-type work orders only: a structured summary of the full scope of work to be executed during the planned outage. Null for non-shutdown work orders.

attributes.name: total_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost for this work order encompassing planned labor, materials, and any additional service costs. Used for maintenance budget approval workflows and CapEx authorization. Corresponds to ESTLABCOST + ESTMATCOST + ESTSERVCOST in Maximo.

attributes.name: tpm_pillar
attributes.description: Classification of the work order under the applicable Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) pillar framework. Enables TPM program performance tracking and OEE improvement analysis. Null if the work order is not part of a formal TPM program.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this work order record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: work_order_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive title or summary of the maintenance task to be performed. Displayed on work order printouts and shop floor scheduling boards. Corresponds to DESCRIPTION in Maximo WORKORDER table.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable work order number assigned by the source system (Maximo or SAP PM). Used for cross-system reference, shop floor communication, and audit trails. Corresponds to WONUM in Maximo and Order Number in SAP PM.

attributes.name: work_order_source
attributes.description: System or channel through which this work order was originated. Enables source system traceability and analysis of maintenance demand drivers (e.g., SCADA alarm-triggered vs. manually created vs. IoT condition-based alert). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: maximo|sap_pm|scada_alarm|iot_alert|manual|inspection|operator_request — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the work order workflow. Tracks progression from creation through approval, material staging, execution, completion, and closure. Corresponds to STATUS field in Maximo WORKORDER table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|waiting_material|in_progress|on_hold|completed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

products.name: pm_schedule
products.description: Preventive maintenance schedule master defining recurring maintenance tasks, inspection intervals, trigger types (calendar-based, meter-based, condition-based), and TPM task sequences for each equipment asset. Stores frequency, last completion date, next due date, estimated duration, required craft skills, and associated job plan reference. Supports TPM pillar execution and regulatory inspection compliance.
products.reference: Maximo Preventive Maintenance / SAP PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the preventive maintenance schedule record. Primary key for the pm_schedule data product.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Preventive‑maintenance schedules are created per component type to align with design‑life expectations.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Preventive Maintenance Contracts: links maintenance schedules to the customer contract holder for compliance reporting and contract billing.

attributes.name: engineering_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.engineering_specification. Business justification: PM schedules are derived from engineering specifications that define OEM-mandated maintenance intervals, torque values, and inspection criteria. Linking enables automatic PM schedule updates when spec

attributes.name: job_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job plan that defines the detailed task steps, materials, tools, and labor requirements for this PM schedule. Job plans are maintained in Maximo and reused across multiple PM schedules.

attributes.name: last_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the most recently generated work order from this PM schedule. Enables direct navigation from the schedule to the latest execution record for status tracking.

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational location (plant, building, production line, or functional location) where the asset subject to this PM schedule resides.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: PM schedules for outsourced maintenance are governed by service contracts defining scope, frequency, and SLAs. Linking PM schedule to contract ensures correct vendor engagement and contract utilizatio

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_agreement. Business justification: PM schedules may be contractually mandated by an SLA (preventive_maintenance_included flag). Linking PM schedules to the governing SLA agreement enables compliance tracking against contractual PM obli

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the maintenance manager or engineering authority who approved this PM schedule for execution. Required for regulatory compliance and quality management system documentation.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PM schedule was formally approved by the authorized maintenance manager or engineering authority. Marks the schedule as valid for work order generation.

attributes.name: asset_pm_schedule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the preventive maintenance schedule, including the scope of work, maintenance objectives, and any special instructions or safety precautions relevant to the task.

attributes.name: condition_threshold_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the condition monitoring threshold value (e.g., mm/s for vibration velocity, °C for temperature, cSt for oil viscosity). Provides context for interpreting condition_threshold_value.

attributes.name: condition_threshold_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value for condition-based PM triggering. When the monitored parameter (e.g., vibration amplitude, temperature, oil viscosity) exceeds this value, a PM work order is generated. Applicable when trigger_type is CONDITION.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PM schedule record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Number of maintenance technicians or craft workers required to execute this PM task simultaneously. Used for labor resource planning and shift scheduling.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated_material_cost field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across global manufacturing sites.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this PM schedule is no longer active and will not generate new work orders. Null for open-ended schedules. Used when an asset is decommissioned or a maintenance program is superseded.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this PM schedule becomes active and eligible to generate work orders. Supports phased rollout of new maintenance programs and asset commissioning workflows.

attributes.name: estimated_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of hours the asset will be unavailable for production during execution of this PM task. Used in OEE calculations, production scheduling, and downtime planning.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of labor hours required to complete the preventive maintenance task. Used for maintenance scheduling, craft resource planning, and downtime window estimation.

attributes.name: estimated_material_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of materials and spare parts required to execute this PM task, in the local operating currency. Used for maintenance budget planning and CapEx/OpEx cost allocation.

attributes.name: frequency_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the PM recurrence frequency. Combined with frequency_value to define the full interval (e.g., 30 DAYS, 500 HOURS, 10000 CYCLES). Determines whether the schedule is calendar-based or meter-based. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAYS|WEEKS|MONTHS|YEARS|HOURS|CYCLES|KILOMETERS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: frequency_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing how often the PM task should recur. Interpreted in conjunction with frequency_unit (e.g., a value of 30 with unit DAYS means every 30 days; a value of 500 with unit HOURS means every 500 operating hours).

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM schedule is mandated by a regulatory body (e.g., OSHA, EPA, UL, CE Marking authority) and must be completed and documented for compliance purposes. Drives audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: is_safety_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM schedule is classified as safety-critical, meaning non-execution could result in personnel injury, environmental incident, or regulatory violation. Safety-critical PMs require mandatory completion tracking.

attributes.name: last_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent execution of this PM schedule was completed and the corresponding work order was closed. Used as the baseline for calculating the next due date.

attributes.name: last_revised_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PM schedule definition was last revised or updated. Supports document control, audit trails, and change management processes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the next_due_date that the PM work order should be generated to allow sufficient time for parts procurement, scheduling, and preparation. Supports JIT maintenance planning.

attributes.name: maintenance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity type. PREVENTIVE: time/usage-based task to prevent failure. PREDICTIVE: condition-monitoring-driven task. INSPECTION: regulatory or quality inspection. LUBRICATION: lubrication task. CALIBRATION: instrument calibration. OVERHAUL: major scheduled overhaul.

attributes.name: meter_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the meter reading used in meter-based PM scheduling (e.g., HOURS for operating hours, CYCLES for press strokes, KILOMETERS for vehicle mileage). Null when trigger_type is CALENDAR only.

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which the next preventive maintenance work order is due to be generated or executed. Derived from last_completion_date plus the frequency interval. Drives maintenance scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: next_due_meter_reading
attributes.description: Meter reading value (e.g., operating hours, cycle count, kilometers) at which the next PM work order is due. Applicable when trigger_type is METER or when a meter-based override supplements calendar scheduling.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this PM schedule, used to rank and sequence work order generation when competing maintenance demands exist. CRITICAL schedules are associated with safety-critical or regulatory-mandated equipment.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard, clause, or requirement that mandates this PM schedule (e.g., 'OSHA 29 CFR 1910.217 Mechanical Power Presses', 'ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.1.5 Monitoring Resources'). Populated when is_regulatory_required is True.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Document revision number for this PM schedule, incremented when the schedule definition is updated (e.g., frequency change, task scope change, job plan update). Supports document control and change management per ISO 9001.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title describing the preventive maintenance schedule (e.g., 'Monthly Lubrication — CNC Spindle', 'Annual Safety Inspection — Conveyor Line 3'). Used for display and search.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the PM schedule, as assigned in Maximo Asset Management. Used for cross-system reference and field communication (e.g., PM-2024-00123).

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the preventive maintenance schedule. ACTIVE schedules generate work orders automatically. SUSPENDED schedules are temporarily paused (e.g., during planned shutdown). CLOSED schedules are retired.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordering sequence number for this PM schedule within a TPM task sequence or maintenance route. Enables ordered execution of multiple PM tasks on the same asset or production line during a maintenance window.

attributes.name: shutdown_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset must be taken offline (production shutdown) to perform this PM task. Critical for production planning and scheduling maintenance windows to minimize OEE impact.

attributes.name: spare_parts_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PM task requires spare parts or consumable materials to be reserved or procured prior to execution. Triggers inventory reservation in WMS or SAP MM when True.

attributes.name: tolerance_days
attributes.description: Allowable number of days before or after the next_due_date within which the PM task can be performed without being considered overdue. Provides scheduling flexibility while maintaining compliance.

attributes.name: tpm_pillar
attributes.description: TPM pillar classification to which this PM schedule belongs. Aligns maintenance activities with the eight TPM pillars: Autonomous Maintenance, Planned Maintenance, Quality Maintenance, Focused Improvement, Early Equipment Management, Education and Training, Safety Health and Environment, Office TPM. CONDITION: condition-based monitoring threshold breach. SEASONAL: tied to seasonal calendar. EVENT: triggered by a specific operational event.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: work_order_count

products.name: job_plan
products.description: Standardized job plan (task list) defining the step-by-step maintenance procedure, required labor crafts, estimated hours per task step, safety precautions, required tools, and spare parts for a specific maintenance activity type. Acts as the reusable template applied to work orders and PM schedules. Sourced from Maximo Job Plans and SAP PM Task Lists.
products.reference: Maximo Job Plan / SAP PM Task List

attributes.name: job_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the job plan record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: component_id
