attributes.description: Reference to the B2B industrial customer, OEM account, distributor, or end-user organization for whom this credit profile is maintained. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit limit and terms were formally approved by the authorized credit manager. Part of the credit governance audit trail required for SOX and IFRS compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the credit manager or authorized approver who approved the current credit limit and terms. Required for segregation of duties (SoD) compliance and audit trail in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: bad_debt_provision_amount
attributes.description: Amount provisioned for potential bad debt loss on this customer's receivables under the IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) model or GAAP ASC 310 allowance method. Maintained in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: bank_account_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's bank account details on file have been verified through the company's bank account validation process. True = verified; False = unverified. Required for direct debit and bank transfer payment methods.

attributes.name: collection_strategy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the dunning and collections strategy assigned to this customer in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR (e.g., standard dunning, escalated collections, legal action track). Drives automated dunning notice generation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and IFRS/GAAP record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: credit_account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit account based on the nature of the customer relationship. Determines applicable credit policies and risk frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: domestic|export|intercompany|distributor|oem|government — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit (credit control area code) responsible for managing and monitoring this customer's credit. Defines the credit management scope and currency for credit limit enforcement in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit hold was applied to the customer account. Used for aging analysis of credit holds and SLA compliance tracking for credit resolution processes.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is currently placed on credit hold, blocking new order processing in SAP S/4HANA SD and Siemens Opcenter MES. True = credit hold active; False = no hold. Synchronized with Salesforce CRM account status.

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the customer account has been placed on credit hold. Required for audit trail and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) processes. Null when credit_hold_flag is False.

attributes.name: credit_hold_released_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit hold was lifted and normal order processing was reinstated. Null if the credit hold is still active. Used for credit resolution cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount under the trade credit insurance policy for this customer, in the account currency. Represents the maximum receivable amount recoverable in case of customer default.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the trade credit insurance policy for this customer expires. Triggers renewal workflow alerts to prevent uninsured credit exposure.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the trade credit insurance policy (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius) covering this customer's receivables. Null if no credit insurance is in place. Used for insurance claim processing and risk mitigation reporting.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the trade credit insurance provider covering this customer's receivables (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius, Credendo). Null if no credit insurance is in place.

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure (in the account currency) that can be extended to the customer at any point in time. Set during credit review and enforced in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit management.

attributes.name: credit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credit analyst notes, special conditions, exceptions, or contextual information relevant to this customer's credit profile. Supports credit review documentation and exception management.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal or external credit risk rating assigned to the customer (e.g., A, B, C, D or numeric score). Used to classify credit risk tier and determine applicable credit terms, insurance requirements, and collection priority. May align with Dun & Bradstreet or internal scoring models.

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Source or agency that issued the credit rating for this customer. Distinguishes between internally-derived ratings and third-party agency assessments used for credit risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|dun_bradstreet|moody|sp|fitch|coface|euler_hermes — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which formal credit reviews are scheduled for this customer. Determined by credit risk tier and customer segment. Higher-risk customers require more frequent reviews.

attributes.name: credit_segment
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA credit segment identifier that groups customers under a common credit management policy and credit limit pool. Enables multi-segment credit management for customers operating across multiple business units or regions.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customer credit profile. Drives order release decisions in SAP S/4HANA SD and MES order management. 'on_hold' and 'blocked' prevent new order processing until resolved.

attributes.name: credit_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved credit limit currently consumed by the outstanding balance (outstanding_balance / credit_limit × 100). Triggers credit hold alerts when threshold is breached. Synchronized from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR credit exposure calculation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit, outstanding balance, and financial terms are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with the customer's billing currency in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: dso_days
attributes.description: Days Sales Outstanding — the average number of days it takes the customer to pay invoices, calculated as (outstanding_balance / total_credit_sales) × number_of_days. A key KPI for accounts receivable performance and cash flow management per IFRS/GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level (1–4) indicating the escalation stage of overdue payment notices sent to the customer. Level 1 = first reminder; Level 4 = final notice before legal action. Managed in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR dunning program.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the customer must pay to qualify for the early payment discount. Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the customer for early payment within the discount period defined in the payment terms (e.g., 2.00 for a 2% early payment discount). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current credit terms, credit limit, and risk classification became effective for this customer. Supports temporal credit management and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit terms and credit limit are scheduled to expire and require renewal or re-assessment. Null for open-ended credit agreements. Triggers next_credit_review_date workflow.

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal credit assessment was completed for this customer. Triggers next review scheduling and is used for credit governance compliance reporting.

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning notice was issued to the customer for overdue invoices. Used to track collections activity and enforce dunning intervals in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit profile record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in Databricks Silver Layer ingestion and audit compliance.

attributes.name: next_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal credit review of this customer. Drives workflow alerts in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and Salesforce CRM for proactive credit management.

attributes.name: oldest_overdue_days
attributes.description: Number of days since the oldest unpaid overdue invoice became due. Used for collections aging bucket analysis and bad debt provisioning triggers in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Total open accounts receivable balance currently owed by the customer in the account currency, as synchronized from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. Includes all open invoices, debit memos, and unapplied credits. Used for credit utilization monitoring.

attributes.name: overdue_amount
attributes.description: Total value of invoices that have exceeded their due date and remain unpaid, in the account currency. A subset of outstanding_balance. Used for collections prioritization and bad debt provisioning per IFRS 9 expected credit loss model.

attributes.name: payment_behavior_score
attributes.description: Internal scoring metric (0–100) reflecting the customer's historical payment behavior, including on-time payment rate, frequency of late payments, and average days late. Inputs into credit rating and risk category determination.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Agreed payment instrument used by the customer for settling invoices (e.g., bank transfer, letter of credit for export customers, direct debit). Configured in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR payment method settings.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the agreed payment schedule for this customer (e.g., NT30 = Net 30, NT60 = Net 60, NT90 = Net 90, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives invoice due date calculation in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from invoice date within which payment is due under the agreed payment terms (e.g., 30 for Net 30, 60 for Net 60, 90 for Net 90). Used for DSO calculation and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification assigned to the customer based on credit rating, payment history, and financial health assessment. Drives credit limit setting, insurance requirements, and collection strategy.

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM Account record ID for this customer, used for bi-directional synchronization of credit status and credit hold flags between SAP S/4HANA FI-AR and Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud.

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP S/4HANA FI-AR customer account number (debtor number) used to uniquely identify the customer in the ERP system. Serves as the business identifier for cross-system reconciliation.

products.name: sla_agreement
products.description: Service Level Agreement records defining contractual service commitments to industrial customers, including response time SLAs, uptime guarantees, on-time delivery targets, and support tier entitlements. Captures SLA type, tier (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze), response time thresholds, resolution time thresholds, penalty clauses, effective date, expiry date, and associated account. Managed via Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SLA agreement record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated customer contact person who receives escalation notifications when SLA thresholds are at risk of breach or have been breached. Links to the contact master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B industrial customer, OEM account, distributor, or end-user organization account to which this SLA agreement applies. Links to the customer account master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.family. Business justification: SLA agreements in manufacturing are scoped to product families for service contract management, warranty coverage reporting, and SLA compliance tracking by product line. The plain-text 'product_line_s

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: In manufacturing, SLA agreements are governed by and derived from sales contracts. Service delivery managers must trace which contract defines the commercial obligations underpinning an SLA. Contract

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: SLA agreements in industrial manufacturing define service commitments for specific physical locations — a plant, facility, or installation site where field service, preventive maintenance, and on-site

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the SLA agreement as displayed in Salesforce Service Cloud and customer-facing documents (e.g., 'Platinum Support SLA — Acme Automation 2024'). Used for identification and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number for the SLA agreement as assigned in Salesforce Service Cloud (e.g., SLA-2024-00123). Used in customer communications, contract documents, and cross-system references.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA agreement: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (past end date without renewal), or terminated (cancelled before end date). Governs whether SLA commitments are enforceable.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent amendment or revision to the SLA agreement was executed and became effective. Null for the original version. Supports change management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: annual_fee
attributes.description: The recurring annual fee charged to the customer for the SLA agreement, in the agreement currency. Used for revenue recognition, billing scheduling in SAP S/4HANA SD, and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA agreement automatically renews upon expiry without requiring a new contract signature. True = auto-renews; False = requires explicit renewal action. Drives renewal workflow automation in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the customer is invoiced for the SLA agreement fee (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual). Drives billing schedule creation in SAP S/4HANA SD and revenue recognition cadence.

attributes.name: contract_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the signed SLA contract document stored in the document management system (e.g., Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SharePoint). Enables traceability to the original legal document.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the SLA agreement over its full term, expressed in the agreement currency. Used for financial reporting, revenue recognition under IFRS 15/ASC 606, and penalty cap calculations.

attributes.name: covered_asset_count
attributes.description: The number of individual equipment units, machines, or installed assets covered under this SLA agreement. Used for capacity planning of field service resources and Maximo Asset Management integration.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the SLA agreement record was first created in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Represents the record audit creation time in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and penalty amounts in this SLA agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SLA agreement becomes contractually binding and service commitments begin. Corresponds to the contract start date in Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SLA agreement ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended agreements. Used to trigger renewal workflows and compliance reporting in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: field_service_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether on-site field service visits are included in the SLA agreement. True = field service dispatches are covered; False = remote support only. Drives field service scheduling and resource allocation in Salesforce Field Service.

attributes.name: governing_law_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this SLA agreement (e.g., USA, DEU). Determines applicable legal and regulatory frameworks for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: initial_response_time_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which the service team must provide an initial acknowledgment or response to a customer-reported incident or service request under this SLA. A core contractual KPI metric tracked in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the SLA agreement record was most recently updated in the source system (Salesforce Service Cloud). Used for incremental data ingestion, change detection, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: max_annual_service_visits
attributes.description: The maximum number of on-site service visits (preventive or corrective) included per year under this SLA agreement. Null if unlimited or not applicable. Used for field service capacity planning and entitlement consumption tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional contractual terms, special conditions, exclusions, or operational notes associated with the SLA agreement that are not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Salesforce Service Cloud Entitlement description.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually committed minimum percentage of orders or shipments that must be delivered on or before the promised delivery date under this SLA. Applicable for on_time_delivery SLA types. Tracked against SAP S/4HANA SD delivery performance.

attributes.name: parent_contract_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the master or parent commercial contract (e.g., Master Service Agreement or Framework Agreement) under which this SLA agreement is issued. Enables hierarchical contract traceability in SAP S/4HANA SD.

attributes.name: penalty_cap_pct
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative penalty or service credit that can be applied over the agreement period, expressed as a percentage of the total contract value. Limits the company's financial liability exposure from SLA breaches.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial or service credit penalties apply to this SLA agreement when contractual thresholds are breached. True = penalty clauses are active; False = no penalty provisions. Drives financial exposure tracking and CAPA processes.

attributes.name: penalty_credit_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the contracted service fee or invoice value that is credited or refunded to the customer for each SLA breach event, as defined in the penalty clause. Null when penalty_clause_applicable is False.

attributes.name: preventive_maintenance_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether scheduled preventive maintenance visits are included as part of the SLA agreement entitlement. True = preventive maintenance is covered; False = corrective/reactive only. Linked to TPM programs managed in Maximo.

attributes.name: remote_monitoring_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether IIoT-based remote monitoring and diagnostics of covered assets is included in the SLA agreement. True = remote monitoring via Aveva SCADA or IIoT platform is active; False = not included.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days before the expiry date by which either party must provide written notice of intent to renew or terminate the SLA agreement. Triggers automated renewal alerts in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: resolution_time_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which a reported incident or service request must be fully resolved under this SLA agreement. Drives escalation rules and penalty clause triggers in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: service_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic region where the SLA service commitments apply, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR). Determines applicable regulatory requirements, support staffing, and logistics SLA parameters.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: The contractual service tier level assigned to this SLA agreement, determining the priority, response speed, and entitlements available to the customer. Platinum is the highest tier; Bronze is the base tier. Drives case prioritization in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA agreement by the primary service commitment it governs: response_time (initial response to incidents), uptime_guarantee (system/equipment availability), on_time_delivery (order fulfillment punctuality), support_entitlement (support tier access), or maintenance_coverage (preventive/corrective maintenance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: response_time|uptime_guarantee|on_time_delivery|support_entitlement|maintenance_coverage|field_service — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: spare_parts_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of spare parts and replacement components is covered under this SLA agreement. True = parts included; False = parts billed separately. Impacts inventory planning in SAP S/4HANA MM and WMS.

attributes.name: support_hours_coverage
attributes.description: The contracted support availability window defining hours per day and days per week during which the service team is obligated to respond (e.g., 8x5 = 8 hours/day, 5 days/week; 24x7 = round-the-clock). Determines staffing and escalation routing in Salesforce Service Cloud.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the SLA agreement was terminated prior to its scheduled expiry date. Null for agreements that are active or expired naturally. Required for financial accrual reversal and CAPA closure in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for early termination of the SLA agreement. Null when the agreement is active or expired naturally. Used for churn analysis, CAPA processes, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: uptime_target_pct
attributes.description: The contractually committed minimum system or equipment availability expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.5 for 99.5% uptime). Applicable for uptime_guarantee SLA types. Used in OEE and availability reporting.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the SLA agreement, incremented each time the agreement is amended or renegotiated. Version 1 is the original agreement. Supports audit trail and change history tracking per ISO 9001 document control requirements.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records of all customer-facing business interactions and touchpoints including sales calls, site visits, product demonstrations, technical consultations, trade show meetings, executive briefings, and customer satisfaction survey responses (NPS). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity (Task/Event). Captures interaction type, channel (phone, email, in-person, virtual, survey), date, duration, participants, outcome, satisfaction score (where applicable), verbatim feedback, follow-up actions, and associated opportunity or account. Supports relationship health monitoring and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer interaction record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the interaction data product.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual customer contact (person) who participated in this interaction. Maps to Salesforce CRM Contact object.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the B2B customer account (OEM, distributor, or end-user organization) associated with this interaction. Maps to Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order_header. Business justification: Customer service interactions in manufacturing (complaints, delivery disputes, quality escalations) are routinely linked to specific orders. This FK enables order-level complaint tracking, CAPA linkag

attributes.name: lead_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_lead. Business justification: In CRM-driven B2B industrial sales, interactions (sales calls, site visits, demos) frequently occur with prospective customers who are still in the lead stage — before conversion to a customer_account

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales opportunity associated with this interaction, if applicable. Links interaction to active deal pipeline in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Customer interactions in manufacturing sales frequently relate to specific quotes (negotiation calls, quote review meetings, price objection handling). Linking interactions to quotes enables quote neg

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Customer interactions in manufacturing (complaints, technical support, CAPA) are tied to specific SKUs. The interaction table has 'capa_reference' and 'is_customer_complaint' confirming this process.

attributes.name: sla_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA agreement governing the response and service standards applicable to this customer interaction. Enables SLA compliance monitoring for after-sales and service interactions.

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that originated or is associated with this interaction (e.g., trade show campaign, email nurture campaign). Links interaction to campaign ROI analysis.

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA record initiated as a result of this interaction, if applicable. Links customer feedback to the formal quality management corrective action process.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication medium or channel through which the interaction was conducted. Supports omnichannel relationship health analysis and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the interaction took place. Supports regional sales performance analysis and compliance with export control regulations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage purposes.

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier of the corresponding Task or Event record in Salesforce CRM. Used for cross-system traceability and delta-load reconciliation from the source system of record.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction content, topics discussed, key decisions made, and context. Supports relationship history review and account management continuity.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed duration of the interaction in minutes as recorded by the interaction owner. Supports engagement depth analysis and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customer interaction concluded. Combined with start timestamp to derive actual interaction duration.

attributes.name: external_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer-side participant names and roles who attended the interaction (e.g., 'John Smith - VP Engineering, Jane Doe - Procurement Manager'). Classified confidential as it contains customer personnel information.

attributes.name: follow_up_action
attributes.description: Description of the specific follow-up action to be taken after this interaction (e.g., 'Send product specification sheet', 'Schedule site visit', 'Prepare PPAP documentation').

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up action resulting from this interaction must be completed. Used for account manager task management and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up action or subsequent interaction is required as a result of this interaction. Drives task creation and account manager workflow.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer interaction took place. Used for day-level scheduling, reporting, and relationship cadence analysis.

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interaction record. Tracks whether the interaction has been planned, is underway, has been completed, or was cancelled or deferred.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between sales-driven, technical, executive, and survey touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_call|site_visit|product_demo|technical_consultation|executive_briefing|trade_show_meeting|nps_survey|email_outreach — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_participants
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employee names or IDs who participated in the interaction (e.g., account manager, field application engineer, product specialist, executive sponsor). Supports multi-stakeholder engagement tracking.

attributes.name: is_customer_complaint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved a formal or informal customer complaint. Triggers CAPA workflow and quality management escalation per ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether an executive sponsor (C-level or VP-level) from the company participated in this interaction. Flags high-touch executive engagement for strategic account management reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was last updated or modified. Supports delta-load processing in the lakehouse pipeline and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Specific name or address of the location where the interaction occurred (e.g., 'Customer HQ - Detroit Plant 3', 'Hannover Messe Hall 9', 'Microsoft Teams'). Supports geographic analysis of customer engagement.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical or virtual location where the interaction took place. Distinguishes between customer-site visits, company-hosted meetings, trade show engagements, and virtual sessions.

attributes.name: next_interaction_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next scheduled customer interaction as agreed during this interaction. Supports proactive account management cadence and relationship continuity planning.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score captured during customer satisfaction survey interactions. Integer value on a 0–10 scale where 0–6 = Detractor, 7–8 = Passive, 9–10 = Promoter. Null for non-survey interaction types.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: High-level result or outcome classification of the interaction. Indicates whether the interaction advanced the relationship, was neutral, resulted in escalation, or outcome is still pending.

attributes.name: outcome_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes elaborating on the interaction outcome, including specific commitments made, objections raised, or next steps agreed upon with the customer.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: Total number of participants (internal and external combined) who attended the interaction. Used for engagement scale analysis and resource planning.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the interaction, reflecting the strategic importance of the customer or the urgency of the topic discussed. Drives account manager workload prioritization.

attributes.name: relationship_health_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–100) representing the assessed health of the customer relationship at the time of this interaction, as rated by the account manager. Distinct from NPS — this is an internal assessment, not a customer-provided score.

attributes.name: satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating on a 1–5 scale collected at the end of the interaction (1 = Very Dissatisfied, 5 = Very Satisfied). Applicable to service calls, technical consultations, and post-delivery reviews.

attributes.name: sentiment_category
attributes.description: Categorized sentiment of the interaction as assessed by the interaction owner or derived from verbatim feedback analysis. Supports relationship health scoring and early warning detection for at-risk accounts.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: System or method through which this interaction record was created or ingested. Supports data lineage tracking and source system reconciliation in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the customer interaction began. Used for duration calculation, scheduling conflict detection, and time-zone-aware reporting.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short descriptive title or subject line summarizing the purpose of the interaction (e.g., 'Q3 Automation System Review', 'PLC Upgrade Technical Demo'). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity Subject field.

attributes.name: verbatim_feedback
attributes.description: Unstructured, verbatim text feedback provided by the customer during or after the interaction. Captured for voice-of-customer (VoC) analysis, sentiment analysis, and continuous improvement programs. Classified confidential as it contains customer-specific business opinions.

Upon qualification and conversion, creates a new customer_account record.

domains.name: product

products.name: sku_master
products.description: Single source of truth for all Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) across the manufactured product portfolio. Captures the authoritative SKU identifier, description, unit of measure, weight, dimensions, hazardous material classification (UN number, hazard class, packing group, SDS reference), export control classification (ECCN), and lifecycle status. Serves as the foundational master record referenced by BOM, MES, ERP (SAP S/4HANA MM), and PLM (Siemens Teamcenter) systems. Every manufactured item, automation system component, electrification solution, and smart infrastructure element is registered here before it can be produced, sold, or shipped. Includes base/sales/production UoM with conversion factors and multi-language commercial descriptions. Note: product pricing structures are owned by the sales domain; this domain owns product identity, structure, and commercial catalog definition only.

attributes.description: Identifier linking the BOM to a specific production process and routing. Enables multiple production methods for the same product with different BOM and routing combinations.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is subject to regulatory compliance requirements (CE marking, UL certification, IEC standards, etc.). Triggers additional documentation and validation workflows.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM structure. Incremented with each Engineering Change Order (ECO) or Engineering Change Notice (ECN) that modifies the BOM.

products.name: product_bom_line
products.description: Individual component line items within a Bill of Materials (BOM), representing the parent-child assembly relationships for manufactured products. Captures component SKU reference, quantity per assembly, unit of measure, item category (stock, non-stock, phantom), scrap factor, lead time offset, alternative item group, and engineering change order (ECO) reference. Supports multi-level BOM explosion for MRP runs in SAP S/4HANA PP and production routing in Siemens Opcenter MES. Each bom_line belongs to exactly one bom_header and references exactly one component from sku_master.
products.reference: SAP BOM Item (CS01), Siemens Teamcenter BOM Line

attributes.name: product_bom_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Bill of Materials (BOM) Line ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the product_bom_line entity.

tag_set.value: Product Bill of Materials (BOM) Line ID

attributes.name: bom_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Each BOM line must belong to exactly one BOM header.

attributes.name: component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.component. Business justification: Production planning reports require each BOM line to reference the engineering component master to ensure design consistency and cost roll‑up.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.drawing. Business justification: Manufacturing execution system uses the drawing ID per BOM line to fetch exact assembly drawings for work orders and quality inspections.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the component material or part from the SKU master data that is required for this assembly. Each BOM line references exactly one component SKU.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work center or production resource where this component is consumed. Used for shop floor material staging and kitting.

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Identifier for a group of interchangeable components that can substitute for each other in the assembly. Used for flexible BOM structures and supply chain resilience.

attributes.name: alternative_item_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this component within its alternative item group. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for material selection during MRP and production execution.

attributes.name: assembly_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this component in the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished product, level 1 is direct sub-assembly, level 2 is sub-sub-assembly, etc. Used for BOM explosion and implosion.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is consumed automatically via backflushing when the operation is confirmed (True) or requires manual goods issue (False). Used in lean manufacturing and MES integration.

attributes.name: bulk_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is a bulk material (liquids, powders, gases) that requires special handling, storage, and measurement during production.

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Internal change control number tracking modifications to this BOM line. Used for audit trail and version control in engineering change management.

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the component part or material used in the assembly, providing additional context beyond the SKU reference.

attributes.name: component_height_mm
attributes.description: Height dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_length_mm
attributes.description: Length dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: component_origin
attributes.description: Procurement strategy for this component: make (manufactured in-house), buy (purchased from supplier), make_or_buy (flexible sourcing), subcontract (outsourced manufacturing).

attributes.name: component_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the component in kilograms. Used for calculating total assembly weight, shipping weight, and material handling requirements.

attributes.name: component_width_mm
attributes.description: Width dimension of the component in millimeters. Used for variable-size materials and spatial planning in assembly.

attributes.name: cost_relevance_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component should be included in product costing calculations. Text items and phantom assemblies are typically not cost-relevant.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical for production and requires special attention in material planning, procurement, and availability checking.

attributes.name: ecn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice that authorized this BOM line change. Provides traceability to engineering change documentation.

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Order that introduced or modified this BOM line. Links BOM changes to formal engineering change management processes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer active and should not be used in new production orders. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes active and should be used in production planning and execution. Supports date-effectivity for phased component changes.

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of parent assembly batch size (True) or scales proportionally with batch size (False). Used for setup materials and consumables.

attributes.name: installation_point
attributes.description: Physical location or position identifier where this component is installed in the parent assembly. Used for assembly instructions and service documentation.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM line item type: stock (regular inventory item), non_stock (direct procurement), phantom (pass-through assembly with no inventory), text (documentation only), variable_size (length/weight variable), co_product (joint output), by_product (secondary output). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock|non_stock|phantom|text|variable_size|co_product|by_product — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the parent assembly start date that this component must be available. Used for backward scheduling in production planning and MRP runs.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the BOM header, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the assembly structure.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this BOM line record. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM line record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, comments, or special handling requirements for this component in the assembly process.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: The routing operation number at which this component is consumed or installed in the manufacturing process. Links BOM to routing for integrated production planning.

attributes.name: product_bom_line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), pending (awaiting approval), obsolete (phased out), blocked (quality hold), released (approved for production).

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The required quantity of this component needed to produce one unit of the parent assembly. Supports up to 6 decimal places for precision in chemical, pharmaceutical, and electronics manufacturing.

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Engineering revision level or version of this BOM line. Tracks design iterations and ensures correct component versions are used in production.

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: Expected scrap or waste percentage for this component during the manufacturing process. Used by MRP to calculate additional material requirements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: spare_part_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is also available as a spare part for after-sales service and maintenance. Used for service parts planning and documentation.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., EA=Each, PC=Piece, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, M=Meter). Must align with the component SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|G|L|ML|M|CM|FT|IN|LB|OZ|SET|BOX|ROLL|SHEET — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: product_specification
products.description: Technical and commercial specifications for manufactured products, automation systems, and electrification solutions. Captures electrical ratings, mechanical dimensions, environmental ratings (IP class, NEMA class), operating temperature range, performance parameters, and application suitability. Includes references to associated technical documentation (datasheets, installation manuals, safety data sheets) managed in the engineering domain's document management system. Serves as the authoritative technical specification record referenced by engineering, quality, and sales teams. Managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP S/4HANA. Note: certification records (UL, CE, IEC, ATEX, RoHS/REACH) are tracked separately in the certification product.
products.reference: PLM Product Specification, IEC/UL/CE Technical Standards

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product in the product catalog. Links this specification to the master product record.

attributes.name: altitude_rating_meters
attributes.description: Maximum operating altitude in meters above sea level. Defines altitude limitations for product operation due to air pressure and cooling considerations.

attributes.name: application_suitability
attributes.description: Intended application areas and use cases. Describes the industrial applications, environments, or processes for which the product is designed and suitable.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version was formally approved. Tracks the approval milestone in the specification lifecycle.

attributes.name: color_finish
attributes.description: Product color and surface finish. Describes the external appearance and coating (e.g., RAL 7035 light grey, powder coated, anodized aluminum).

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Supported communication protocols for data exchange. Lists the industrial communication standards the product supports (e.g., PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, OPC UA).

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Electrical connection or terminal type. Describes the method for connecting wires or cables to the product (e.g., screw terminals, spring clamp, plug connector).

attributes.name: current_rating_amperes
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current rating in amperes. Defines the electrical current capacity of the product.

attributes.name: datasheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the associated product datasheet. Links to the detailed technical datasheet managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: dimensions_height_mm
attributes.description: Product height dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical height for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_length_mm
attributes.description: Product length dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical length for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: dimensions_width_mm
attributes.description: Product width dimension in millimeters. Defines the physical width for installation planning and space requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version becomes effective and applicable for use in engineering, manufacturing, and sales processes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification version is no longer valid or has been superseded by a newer revision. Null for active specifications without planned obsolescence.

attributes.name: frequency_rating_hz
attributes.description: Operating frequency rating in Hertz. Specifies the electrical frequency the product is designed for (e.g., 50Hz, 60Hz, 50/60Hz).

attributes.name: humidity_rating_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity rating or range for product operation. Specifies the acceptable humidity conditions (e.g., 5-95% RH non-condensing).

attributes.name: installation_manual_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the installation manual. Links to the installation instructions managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: ip_rating
attributes.description: Ingress Protection rating per IEC 60529 standard. Defines the level of protection against solid objects and liquids (e.g., IP65, IP67, IP20).

attributes.name: material_composition
attributes.description: Primary materials used in product construction. Lists the key materials and their properties (e.g., stainless steel housing, polycarbonate cover, copper conductors).

attributes.name: mounting_type
attributes.description: Physical mounting method for the product. Specifies how the product is installed (e.g., DIN rail, panel mount, wall mount).

attributes.name: nema_rating
attributes.description: NEMA enclosure rating for North American markets. Defines environmental protection level (e.g., NEMA1, NEMA4, NEMA4X, NEMA12).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the specification. Captures supplementary information for engineering, quality, or sales teams.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum operating ambient temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for safe and reliable product operation.

attributes.name: performance_parameter
attributes.description: Key performance parameters and metrics. Describes critical performance characteristics such as response time, accuracy, throughput, or efficiency ratings specific to the product type.

attributes.name: power_rating_watts
attributes.description: Electrical power rating in watts. Specifies the maximum power consumption or output capacity of the product.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was first created in the system. Tracks the initial capture of the specification data.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to any field in the specification record.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier for the specification document. Tracks changes and updates over time.

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet. Links to the SDS document for products containing hazardous materials, managed in the engineering document management system.

attributes.name: shock_resistance
attributes.description: Mechanical shock resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical shock per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-27).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this specification record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specification_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the product specification. Provides comprehensive technical and commercial details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the product specification. Describes the specification purpose or scope.

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the product specification document. Used for external reference and traceability across engineering, quality, and sales teams.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product specification. Tracks the approval and active state of the specification document.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification document type. Indicates whether the specification covers technical parameters, commercial terms, or a combination.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the upper temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Defines the lower temperature limit for product storage when not in operation.

attributes.name: technical_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for associated technical drawings. Links to CAD drawings, dimensional drawings, or assembly drawings managed in the PLM system.

attributes.name: vibration_resistance
attributes.description: Vibration resistance specification. Describes the products ability to withstand mechanical vibration per applicable test standards (e.g., IEC 60068-2-6).

attributes.name: voltage_rating
attributes.description: Electrical voltage rating or range for the product. Specifies the nominal operating voltage and acceptable voltage range (e.g., 24VDC, 110-240VAC, 400V 3-phase).

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Product weight in kilograms. Defines the mass for shipping, handling, and installation planning.

products.name: plant_data
products.description: Plant-specific master data extensions for each SKU, capturing manufacturing plant assignment, MRP type, lot size procedure, safety stock level, reorder point, planned delivery time, production storage location, and quality inspection type. Represents the SAP S/4HANA MM/PP plant view of the material master, enabling plant-level production planning, MRP runs, and inventory management. Each SKU may have different plant data records per manufacturing facility.

attributes.name: plant_data_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plant_data

attributes.name: issue_stock_location_id

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku_master. Business justification: Associate plant‑specific data with the SKU it describes; enables plant‑level planning per SKU

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC classification for inventory management prioritization. A=High-value items requiring tight control, B=Medium-value items, C=Low-value items with relaxed control.

attributes.name: availability_check_group
attributes.description: Two-character key that controls which stock types are included in ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks for sales orders and production orders.

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether components are backflushed (automatically issued) when production order confirmations are posted. True=Backflush enabled, False=Manual goods issue required.

attributes.name: batch_management_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether batch/lot tracking is required for this material at this plant. True=Batch management active, False=No batch tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_counting_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code that determines the frequency of cycle counting for this material. Used to schedule physical inventory counts.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this material will be discontinued at this plant. Used for phase-out planning and last-time-buy notifications.

attributes.name: effective_out_date
attributes.description: Date from which this plant data record becomes inactive. Used to manage time-dependent plant data changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size

attributes.name: gr_processing_time_days

attributes.name: in_house_production_time_days
attributes.description: Number of working days required to manufacture this material from raw materials to finished goods at this plant. Used in production scheduling and MRP.

attributes.name: inspection_setup_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality inspection setup (inspection lot creation) is required for goods receipts of this material at this plant. True=Inspection required, False=No inspection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plant data record was last updated.

attributes.name: lot_size_procedure
attributes.description: Lot-sizing procedure used in MRP to determine order quantities. EX=Lot-for-lot, HB=Replenish to maximum stock level, FX=Fixed lot size, WB=Weekly lot size, PK=Period lot size, LS=Lot size key.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique material identifier (SKU) from the material master. Links this plant data record to the global material master.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Target maximum inventory level for this material at this plant. Used in replenishment planning to determine order quantities.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single lot for this material at this plant. Used in MRP calculations.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required for goods receipt acceptance. Batches with less remaining shelf life are rejected.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this plant data record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mrp_controller

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PD|VB|VM|VV|ND|R1|R2 — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.description: Number of calendar days from order placement to goods receipt. Used by MRP to schedule procurement proposals and calculate reorder points.

attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the manufacturing plant or facility where this material is produced or stocked. Each plant has its own plant data record for a given material.

attributes.name: plant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this material at this plant. Active=Normal production/sales, Blocked=Temporarily unavailable, Discontinued=End-of-life, Phase_out=Being phased out, New_product_introduction=NPI stage.

attributes.description: Indicates how the material is procured at this plant. E=In-house production, F=External procurement (purchasing), X=Both production and external procurement.

attributes.name: production_storage_location

attributes.name: profit_center

attributes.name: quality_inspection_type

attributes.name: rounding_value

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or file path to the digitally stored executed sales contract document. Links to document management system or secure repository.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract becomes legally binding and enforceable. Marks the start of the contract period and triggers obligations for both parties.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the sales contract ends and obligations cease. Nullable for open-ended contracts or contracts with indefinite terms subject to termination clauses.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions excusing non-performance due to unforeseeable events beyond parties control such as natural disasters, war, pandemics, or government actions. Defines qualifying events and relief procedures.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and body of law that governs the interpretation, enforcement, and dispute resolution of the sales contract. Typically specifies country and state/province.

attributes.name: incoterms

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales contract record was last updated in the system. Part of audit trail for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: penalty_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provisions defining financial penalties or liquidated damages for non-performance, late delivery, or breach of SLA commitments. Specifies penalty amounts, triggers, and caps.

attributes.description: Provisions governing automatic renewal, renewal options, or renegotiation terms at contract expiration. Defines renewal notice periods, pricing adjustments, and renewal conditions.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to a customer for product sales, service contracts, or project-based engagements. Captures invoice number, issue date, due date, billing period, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, currency, invoice status (draft, issued, partially_paid, paid, overdue, cancelled, disputed, written_off), invoice type (standard, credit_note, debit_note, proforma, self_billing), payment terms code, billing address, PO reference, contract reference, and source transaction reference. Serves as the SSOT for credit notes (returns, pricing corrections, quality disputes, volume rebate settlements) and debit notes (price adjustments, surcharges, underbilling corrections) via the invoice_type discriminator. Also supports self-billing/evaluated receipt settlement (ERS) for consignment and VMI arrangements. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD/FI billing document types (VF01/VF04).

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value committed under this procurement contract for value-based contracts, or estimated total spend for quantity-based contracts.

attributes.name: document_date

attributes.name: document_number

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt document. Indicates whether the GR is in draft, posted to inventory, blocked for quality issues, cancelled, or reversed.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_value

attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the type of goods receipt transaction (e.g., 101 for GR against PO, 501 for GR without PO). Drives inventory and financial posting logic.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods must undergo quality inspection before being released to unrestricted inventory. True if inspection is required; false otherwise.

attributes.description: Current status of the quality inspection process for the received goods. Determines whether goods can be moved to unrestricted stock or must remain in quality hold.

attributes.description: The difference between the received quantity and the ordered quantity. Positive values indicate over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery.

attributes.description: The quantity of material or service units physically received and recorded in this goods receipt. Used for inventory update and three-way match validation.

attributes.description: The name of the individual who physically received and inspected the goods. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.description: The code of the manufacturing plant or facility that received the goods. Used for multi-plant inventory and cost center allocation.

attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt has been reversed. Links to the cancelling document for audit trail.

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
